changes.key: PHLOX: Ideally, they’ll only need to activate once the project succeeds; as a safety measure, however, the statues will also activate in the event of equipment failure.

changes.english: RAMIE: They will? Why is that?
changes.previous: RAMIE: They will? Why is that?
changes.chinese: 瑞米：真的吗？那是为什么？
changes.key: RAMIE: They will? Why is that?

changes.english: PHLOX: If anything goes wrong with the Ash Twin Project, the statues (and their masks) will make us aware of the situation and enable us to fix it. Otherwise, it would be possible for us to remain permanently unaware of the problem.
changes.previous: PHLOX: If anything goes wrong with the Ash Twin Project, the statues (and their masks) will make us aware of the situation and enable us to fix it. Otherwise, it would be possible for us to remain permanently unaware of the problem.
changes.chinese: 弗拉克斯：如果灰烬双星计划出现问题，雕像（还有它们的面具）可以把情况通知给我们，让我们进行修复。不然的话，我们就可能永远也不知道出了什么问题。
changes.key: PHLOX: If anything goes wrong with the Ash Twin Project, the statues (and their masks) will make us aware of the situation and enable us to fix it. Otherwise, it would be possible for us to remain permanently unaware of the problem.

changes.english: RAMIE: I hadn't thought of that! What a profoundly horrific thought that would be.
changes.previous: RAMIE: I hadn’t thought of that! What a profoundly horrific fate that would be.
changes.chinese: 瑞米：这我倒是没想过！那将会多么可怕的情况啊。
changes.key: RAMIE: I hadn’t thought of that! What a profoundly horrific fate that would be.

changes.english: YARROW: I have exciting news, Privet: the Ash Twin Project is almost prepared to receive the probe data from the Orbital Probe Cannon.
changes.previous: YARROW: I have exciting news, Privet: The Ash Twin Project is almost prepared to receive the probe data from the Orbital Probe Cannon.
changes.chinese: 亚罗：我有一些激动人心的消息，普利维特：灰烬双星计划即将准备就绪，可以接受轨道探测炮传来的探测器数据了。
changes.key: YARROW: I have exciting news, Privet: The Ash Twin Project is almost prepared to receive the probe data from the Orbital Probe Cannon.

changes.english: YARROW: Ramie is adding some finishing touches here, but she'll be finished soon. Are you and the Orbital Probe Cannon well?
changes.previous: YARROW: Ramie is adding some finishing touches here, but she’ll be finished soon. Are you and the Orbital Probe Cannon well?
changes.chinese: 亚罗：瑞米正在做最后的收尾工作，不过她马上就能完工。你和轨道探测炮都没问题吧？
changes.key: YARROW: Ramie is adding some finishing touches here, but she’ll be finished soon. Are you and the Orbital Probe Cannon well?

changes.english: PRIVET: We are! The Probe Tracking Module is ready to record each launch's flight trajectory and will automatically transmit all relevant data to you.
changes.previous: PRIVET: We are! The statue here in the Probe Tracking Module is ready to record each launch’s flight trajectory and will automatically transmit all relevant data to you.
changes.chinese: 普利维特：没问题！探测器跟踪模块已经就绪，能够记录每次发射的飞行轨迹，并且会把相关的数据自动传给你。
changes.key: PRIVET: We are! The statue here in the Probe Tracking Module is ready to record each launch’s flight trajectory and will automatically transmit all relevant data to you.

changes.english: PRIVET: On the other appendage, I'm now worried about this cannon's structural integrity and its crew's moral integrity.
changes.previous: PRIVET: On the other appendage, I’m now worried about this cannon’s structural integrity and its crew’s moral integrity.
changes.chinese: 普利维特：而另一方面，我现在担心的是这门大炮的结构还有乘员的精神是不是健全。
changes.key: PRIVET: On the other appendage, I’m now worried about this cannon’s structural integrity and its crew’s moral integrity.

changes.english: PRIVET: Once the probe determines the location of the Eye of the universe, I'll send an alert directly to you and Ramie.
changes.previous: PRIVET: Once the probe determines the location of the Eye of the universe, I’ll send an alert directly to you and Ramie.
changes.chinese: 普利维特：一旦探测器发现宇宙之眼的位置，我就会直接通知你和瑞米。
changes.key: PRIVET: Once the probe determines the location of the Eye of the universe, I’ll send an alert directly to you and Ramie.

changes.english: COLEUS: After closer observation, mining site 2a wouldn't be safe for the native life dwelling in some cave pools, so (unfortunately) we'll have to mine one of the other sites.
changes.previous: COLEUS: After closer observation, mining site 2a wouldn’t be safe for the native life dwelling in some of this cave’s pools, so (unfortunately) we’ll have to mine one of the other sites.
changes.chinese: 科利耶斯：在经过更加近距离的观察之后，采矿点2a已经不适合当地生命在这个洞窟的某些池塘里居住了，因此（很遗憾），我们只能去其它地点展开开采工作。
changes.key: COLEUS: After closer observation, mining site 2a wouldn’t be safe for the native life dwelling in some of this cave’s pools, so (unfortunately) we’ll have to mine one of the other sites.

changes.english: COLEUS: On the opposite hand, new life! This species is semi-aquatic, and very hardy. The ecosystem here is quite robust, so I believe they'll thrive in the long run. Be cautious near the pools if you visit 2a to meet them.
changes.previous: COLEUS: On the opposite hand, new life! This species is semi-aquatic, and very hardy. The ecosystem here is quite robust, so I believe they’ll thrive in the long run. Be cautious near the pools if you visit 2a to meet them.
changes.chinese: 科利耶斯：而另一方面，这意味着出现了新的生命！这是一种半水生物种，而且适应力极强。这里的生态系统相当坚挺，因此我相信假以时日，它们一定可以茁壮繁衍。假如你来2a参观这些生物，靠近池塘的时候要当心。
changes.key: COLEUS: On the opposite hand, new life! This species is semi-aquatic, and very hardy. The ecosystem here is quite robust, so I believe they’ll thrive in the long run. Be cautious near the pools if you visit 2a to meet them.

changes.english: COLEUS: They remind me of a subterranean species that my mentor, Melorae, once told me about (from when our clan used to travel across this universe). I am sure she would have enjoyed these lifeforms greatly.
changes.previous: COLEUS: They remind me of a subterranean species that my mentor, Melorae, once told me about (from when our clan used to travel across this universe). I imagine she would have enjoyed these lifeforms greatly.
changes.chinese: 科利耶斯：它们让我想起了我的导师梅洛瑞曾经跟我说过的一种地下物种（当时我们家族经常在这个宇宙里航行）。我想她一定会非常喜欢这些生命形式。
changes.key: COLEUS: They remind me of a subterranean species that my mentor, Melorae, once told me about (from when our clan used to travel across this universe). I imagine she would have enjoyed these lifeforms greatly.

changes.english: CYCAD: I was watching them once during a rest, and the hours escaped from me. They're fascinating (in wonder what their fourth eye does)!
changes.previous: CYCAD: I was watching them once during a rest, and the hours escaped from me. They’re fascinating (I wonder what their fourth eye does)!
changes.chinese: 赛卡德：有一次休息的时候我观察过它们，一下子就看入迷了。它们真是有意思（不知道它们的第四只眼睛是用来干什么的）！
changes.key: CYCAD: I was watching them once during a rest, and the hours escaped from me. They’re fascinating (I wonder what their fourth eye does)!

changes.english: CYCAD: There are a few other sites that look promising. What about site 2b (it shares similar formations and databases)?
changes.previous: CYCAD: There are a few other cave sites that look promising. What about site 2b (it shares similar formations and strata)?
changes.chinese: 赛卡德：有几个洞窟看上去可以满足条件。2b这个位置怎么样（那里的地质结构和岩层与2a类似）？
changes.key: CYCAD: There are a few other cave sites that look promising. What about site 2b (it shares similar formations and strata)?

changes.english: OENO: This sounds promising! Will you and your mentor investigate? If mining site 2b proves safe for this native species, we'll move our work there.
changes.previous: OENO: This sounds promising! Will you and your mentor investigate? If mining site 2b proves safe for this native species, we’ll move our work there.
changes.chinese: 奥埃诺：听上去很可行！你和你的导师能不能去调查一下？如果采矿点2b适合这种当地物种生存，我们就把工作地点搬到那里去。
changes.key: OENO: This sounds promising! Will you and your mentor investigate? If mining site 2b proves safe for this native species, we’ll move our work there.

changes.english: CYCAD: Site 2b is safe! Coleus says we’ll continue to monitor our activity and its effect on life here.
changes.previous: CYCAD: Site 2b is safe! Coleus says we’ll continue to monitor our activity and its effect on life here.
changes.chinese: 赛卡德：2b是安全的！科利耶斯说我们会继续监控自己的活动，以及该活动对这里的生命所造成的影响。
changes.key: CYCAD: Site 2b is safe! Coleus says we’ll continue to monitor our activity and its effect on life here.

changes.english: THATCH: Where should this new, more sophisticated locator be built? It may need to be larger than this Eye signal locator is.
changes.previous: THATCH: Where should this new, more sophisticated locator be built? It may need to be larger than this Eye signal locator is.
changes.chinese: 萨奇：这台更加复杂的新型定位器要建在哪里？占地规模可能得比眼信号定位器要大。
changes.key: THATCH: Where should this new, more sophisticated locator be built? It may need to be larger than this Eye signal locator is.

changes.english: COLEUS: Annona and those of us originally stranded on the Ember Twin built a Quantum Moon locator there, but the heat of the sun made its construction challenging. I wouldn't recommend building on that planet.
changes.previous: COLEUS: Annona and those of us originally stranded on Ember Twin built a Quantum Moon locator there, but the heat of the sun made its construction challenging. I wouldn’t recommend building on that planet.
changes.chinese: 科利耶斯：安诺纳还有我们一开始被困在余烬双星的人在那里造了一台量子卫星定位器，可是太阳的热辐射让工程变得十分艰难。我不建议在那颗行星上进行建造。
changes.key: COLEUS: Annona and those of us originally stranded on Ember Twin built a Quantum Moon locator there, but the heat of the sun made its construction challenging. I wouldn’t recommend building on that planet.

changes.english: PLUME: The southern glacier on Brittle Hollow has ample available space. I could construct a new building to house this proposed locator.
changes.previous: PLUME: The southern glacier on Brittle Hollow has ample available space. I could construct a new building to house this proposed locator.
changes.chinese: 普鲁姆：碎空星的南部冰川拥有充足的可用空间。我可以在那里新建一栋建筑来安置这台定位器。
changes.key: PLUME: The southern glacier on Brittle Hollow has ample available space. I could construct a new building to house this proposed locator.

changes.english: FILIX: Yes, let's build there! I imagine our young friend Conoy would enjoy that immensely. He's always had a great interest in the Eye, especially for a child born so long after the crash.
changes.previous: FILIX: Yes, let’s build there! I imagine our young friend Conoy would enjoy that immensely. He’s always held a great interest in the Eye, especially for a child born so long after the crash.
changes.chinese: 费利克斯：好的，就建在那里吧！我想我们年轻的朋友科诺伊一定会非常喜欢。作为一个坠机之后出生的孩子，他一向对眼兴趣盎然。
changes.key: FILIX: Yes, let’s build there! I imagine our young friend Conoy would enjoy that immensely. He’s always held a great interest in the Eye, especially for a child born so long after the crash.

changes.english: PLUME: I will begin construction on Brittle Hollow’s south pole immediately, then!
changes.previous: PLUME: I will begin construction on Brittle Hollow’s south pole immediately, then!
changes.chinese: 普鲁姆：那么，我马上就去碎空星的南极开工！
changes.key: PLUME: I will begin construction on Brittle Hollow’s south pole immediately, then!

changes.english: THATCH: Is everyone unharmed?
changes.previous: THATCH: Is everyone unharmed?
changes.chinese: 萨奇：所有人都没事吧？
changes.key: THATCH: Is everyone unharmed?

changes.english: PLUME: No one was badly injured from the escape pod's impact. We're incredibly fortunate.
changes.previous: PLUME: No one was badly injured from the escape pod’s impact. We’re incredibly fortunate.
changes.chinese: 普鲁姆：没有人因为逃生舱的冲击而受重伤。我们真是太走运了。
changes.key: PLUME: No one was badly injured from the escape pod’s impact. We’re incredibly fortunate.

changes.english: THATCH: This is good news, at least. Have we heard from escape pod 2 or escape pod 3?
changes.previous: THATCH: This is good news, at least. Have we heard from Escape Pod 2 or Escape Pod 3?
changes.chinese: 萨奇：至少这算是个好消息。我们有2号逃生舱或者3号逃生舱的消息吗？
changes.key: THATCH: This is good news, at least. Have we heard from Escape Pod 2 or Escape Pod 3?

changes.english: FILIX: No, I… I'm unable to make contact. My equipment can hear the other two escape pod's signals, though. If it's any comfort, both pods must be structurally intact.
changes.previous: FILIX: No, I... I’m unable to make contact. My equipment can hear the other two escape pods’ distress signals, however. If it’s any comfort, both pods must be structurally intact.
changes.chinese: 费利克斯：没有，我……我无法进行联络。不过，我的设备可以收到其它两个逃生舱的求救信号。两个逃生舱的结构应该都完好无损。不知道这个消息对你是不是有帮助。
changes.key: FILIX: No, I... I’m unable to make contact. My equipment can hear the other two escape pods’ distress signals, however. If it’s any comfort, both pods must be structurally intact.

changes.english: FILIX: I'll continue calling for them.
changes.previous: FILIX: I’ll continue calling for them.
changes.chinese: 费利克斯：我会继续呼叫他们。
changes.key: FILIX: I’ll continue calling for them.

changes.english: THATCH: My gratitude. If we can -
changes.previous: THATCH: My gratitude. If we can —
changes.chinese: 萨奇：感激不尽。如果我们可以……
changes.key: THATCH: My gratitude. If we can —

changes.english: PLUME: Thatch, the moon is approaching again!
changes.previous: PLUME: Thatch, the moon is approaching again!
changes.chinese: 普鲁姆：萨奇，卫星又接近了！
changes.key: PLUME: Thatch, the moon is approaching again!

changes.english: THATCH: Everyone brace yourselves, swiftly! The volcanic moon has returned!
changes.previous: THATCH: Everyone brace yourselves, swiftly! The volcanic moon has returned!
changes.chinese: 萨奇：所有人做好准备，快！火山卫星回来了！
changes.key: THATCH: Everyone brace yourselves, swiftly! The volcanic moon has returned!

changes.english: THATCH: Be cautious of falling ash and debris!
changes.previous: THATCH: Be cautious of falling ash and debris!
changes.chinese: 萨奇：当心掉下来的火山灰和岩屑！
changes.key: THATCH: Be cautious of falling ash and debris!

changes.english: PLUME: … I believe the moon has passed.
changes.previous: PLUME: ...I believe the moon has passed.
changes.chinese: 普鲁姆：……我想卫星已经走了。
changes.key: PLUME: ...I believe the moon has passed.

changes.english: FILIX: This planet doesn't appear eager to have guests. We are certainly unwelcome on this planet.
changes.previous: FILIX: This planet doesn’t appear eager to have guests. We are certainly unwelcome on its surface.
changes.chinese: 费利克斯：这颗行星看来不是很好客。显然我们在它的地表上不受欢迎。
changes.key: FILIX: This planet doesn’t appear eager to have guests. We are certainly unwelcome on its surface.

changes.english: THATCH: We need to find shelter, and quickly. The volcanic moon won't be gone for long.
changes.previous: THATCH: We need to find shelter, and quickly. The volcanic moon won’t be gone for long.
changes.chinese: 萨奇：我们得寻找庇护所，而且要快。那颗火山卫星很快就会再回来的。
changes.key: THATCH: We need to find shelter, and quickly. The volcanic moon won’t be gone for long.

changes.english: PLUME: I observed several promising sites below the surface, but we'll need to construct a way for everyone to climb safely down this cliff. Perhaps we could safely build platforms?
changes.previous: PLUME: I observed several promising sites below the surface, but we’ll need to construct a way for everyone to climb safely down this cliff. Perhaps we could build platforms?
changes.chinese: 普鲁姆：我在地下观察到几个可行的位置，不过我们得造一条路，让大家能够安全地从悬崖上爬下去。也许我们可以建造一些平台？
changes.key: PLUME: I observed several promising sites below the surface, but we’ll need to construct a way for everyone to climb safely down this cliff. Perhaps we could build platforms?

changes.english: THATCH: This knowledge is too dear to lose: Here is everything we recall about the signal we encountered while aboard the Vessel.
changes.previous: THATCH: This knowledge is too dear to lose: Here is everything we can recall about the signal we encountered while aboard the Vessel.
changes.chinese: 萨奇：这一知识十分关键，一定要保存下来：关于我们在飞船上收到的那个信号，我们所记得的情况都在这里。
changes.key: THATCH: This knowledge is too dear to lose: Here is everything we can recall about the signal we encountered while aboard the Vessel.

changes.english: FILIX: The signal looked like an eye: Round, with a circle at the centre much like a pupil. (Suppose the signal was looking for something.)
changes.previous: FILIX: The signal looked like an eye: round, with a circle at the center much like a pupil. (Suppose the signal was looking for something.)
changes.chinese: 费利克斯：那个信号看上去像是一只眼睛，中央有个与瞳孔十分类似的圆形。（估计信号在寻找什么东西。）
changes.key: FILIX: The signal looked like an eye: round, with a circle at the center much like a pupil. (Suppose the signal was looking for something.)

changes.english: FILIX: The signal was older than the universe itself! This is the most significant detail.
changes.previous: FILIX: The signal was older than the universe itself! This is the most significant detail.
changes.chinese: 费利克斯：那个信号比宇宙本身还要古老！这是最重要的细节。
changes.key: FILIX: The signal was older than the universe itself! This is the most significant detail.

changes.english: PLUME: No Nomai clan has ever encountered anything like it! How can anything in this universe be older than the universe itself?
changes.previous: PLUME: No Nomai clan has ever encountered anything like it! How can anything in this universe be older than the universe itself?
changes.chinese: 普鲁姆：以前从来没有哪个挪麦家族遇到过这样的东西！这个宇宙里怎么会有比宇宙本身还要古老的对象？
changes.key: PLUME: No Nomai clan has ever encountered anything like it! How can anything in this universe be older than the universe itself?

changes.english: THATCH: Imagine what rare and profound knowledge it might offer. We *must* find this Eye of the universe.
changes.previous: THATCH: Imagine what rare and profound knowledge it might offer. We must find this Eye of the universe.
changes.chinese: 萨奇：想想看，我们将会从它的身上了解到多么少有以及深远的知识。我们必须找到这个宇宙之眼。
changes.key: THATCH: Imagine what rare and profound knowledge it might offer. We must find this Eye of the universe.

changes.english: KOUSA: We can hear the other escape pod’s distress signals, which gives me hope. Foli, are you still here? I am unsure how to survive in this place without you.
changes.previous: KOUSA: We can hear the other escape pods’ distress signals, which gives me hope. Foli, are you still here? I am unsure how to survive in this place without you.
changes.chinese: 库萨：我们可以听到其它逃生舱的求救信号，这给了我希望。弗利，你还在吗？真不知道没有你，我该怎么在这个地方活下去。
changes.key: KOUSA: We can hear the other escape pods’ distress signals, which gives me hope. Foli, are you still here? I am unsure how to survive in this place without you.

changes.english: KOUSA: (I am unsure how to be me without you.)
changes.previous: KOUSA: (I am unsure how to be me without you.)
changes.chinese: 库萨：（真不知道没有你我该怎么办。）
changes.key: KOUSA: (I am unsure how to be me without you.)

changes.english: PLUME: My brother wasn't in escape pod 1 with us. Was he in pod 2, or pod 3? Was he able to board an escape pod at all?
changes.previous: PLUME: My brother wasn’t in Escape Pod 1 with us. Was he in Pod 2, or Pod 3? Was he able to board an escape pod at all?
changes.chinese: 普鲁姆：我的兄弟没有和我们一起登上1号逃生舱。他会不会在2号逃生舱，或是3号逃生舱里？他到底有没有登上逃生舱？
changes.key: PLUME: My brother wasn’t in Escape Pod 1 with us. Was he in Pod 2, or Pod 3? Was he able to board an escape pod at all?

changes.english: PLUME: We sacrificed too much arriving here. I cannot (I *will* not) allow our clan's greatest loss to be in vain.
changes.previous: PLUME: We sacrificed too much arriving here. I cannot (I will not) allow our clan’s greatest loss to be in vain.
changes.chinese: 普鲁姆：为了能够来到这里，我们做出了太多牺牲。我们的家族蒙受了最为惨重的损失，我不能（我不会）无功而返。
changes.key: PLUME: We sacrificed too much arriving here. I cannot (I will not) allow our clan’s greatest loss to be in vain.

changes.english: THATCH: Is the hardest part of this tragedy not knowing who we may have lost? Or will the hardest part come later, when we learn? (Be well, aunt Melorae...)
changes.previous: THATCH: Is the hardest part of this tragedy not knowing who we may have lost? Or will the hardest part come later, when we learn? (Be well, Aunt Melorae...)
changes.chinese: 萨奇：难道说，这个方案最令人难以接受的部分，在于我们不知道将会失去谁？或是说最严峻的考验还在后头？（多保重，梅洛瑞姨妈……）
changes.key: THATCH: Is the hardest part of this tragedy not knowing who we may have lost? Or will the hardest part come later, when we learn? (Be well, Aunt Melorae...)

changes.english: PLUME: The pain of your absence is sharp and haunting, and I would give anything not to know it; anything but never knowing you at all (which would be worse).
changes.previous: PLUME: The pain of your absence is sharp and haunting, and I would give anything not to know it; anything but never knowing you at all (which would be worse).
changes.chinese: 普鲁姆：你不在让我心如刀绞。如果能让我好过一些，我愿意付出一切代价。一切代价，除了无法与你相识（那样的话我会更加痛不欲生）。
changes.key: PLUME: The pain of your absence is sharp and haunting, and I would give anything not to know it; anything but never knowing you at all (which would be worse).

changes.english: PLUME: I can only hope that you are safe, Keek, wherever you are.
changes.previous: PLUME: I can only hope that you are safe, Keek, wherever you are.
changes.chinese: 普鲁姆：无论你在哪儿，奇克，我只希望你能够平安无事。
changes.key: PLUME: I can only hope that you are safe, Keek, wherever you are.

changes.english: PLUME: Given concerns about our settlements stability, where should we construct a new, less temporary shelter?
changes.previous: PLUME: Given concerns about our settlement’s stability, where should we construct a new, less temporary shelter?
changes.chinese: 普鲁姆：鉴于我们定居点的坚固程度，我们是不是应该建造一个比较长期的新庇护所？
changes.key: PLUME: Given concerns about our settlement’s stability, where should we construct a new, less temporary shelter?

changes.english: THATCH: We need to stay close to the escape pod so Filix can monitor incoming messages. We can't be rescued if we aren't present to respond.
changes.previous: THATCH: We need to stay close to the escape pod so Filix can monitor incoming messages. We can’t be rescued if we aren’t present to respond.
changes.chinese: 萨奇：我们得待在逃生舱附近，这样费利克斯才能对传来的消息进行监控。如果我们不进行回应，那么别人就没法把我们救走。
changes.key: THATCH: We need to stay close to the escape pod so Filix can monitor incoming messages. We can’t be rescued if we aren’t present to respond.

changes.english: FILIX: I don't believe anyone is coming to save us, Thatch. Now we must save ourselves.
changes.previous: FILIX: I don’t believe anyone is coming to save us, Thatch. Now we must save ourselves.
changes.chinese: 费利克斯：我觉得不会有人来救我们了，萨奇。现在我们必须靠自己才行。
changes.key: FILIX: I don’t believe anyone is coming to save us, Thatch. Now we must save ourselves.

changes.english: PLUME: I agree. We're here because the Eye's signal called to us and we followed. If we're to find it, we need to not merely survive, but thrive.
changes.previous: PLUME: I agree. We’re here because the Eye’s signal called to us and we followed. If we’re to find it, we need to not merely survive, but thrive.
changes.chinese: 普鲁姆：我同意。我们收到了眼的信号，跟着它才来到了这里。如果能够找到它，那么我们不但可以活下来，还能繁衍生息。
changes.key: PLUME: I agree. We’re here because the Eye’s signal called to us and we followed. If we’re to find it, we need to not merely survive, but thrive.

changes.english: THATCH: This is a wise point, Plume, and eloquently made. If moving to the Northern glacier will keep us safer, then that is what we should do.
changes.previous: THATCH: This is a wise point, Plume, and eloquently made. If moving to the northern glacier will keep us safer, then that is what we should do.
changes.chinese: 萨奇：你的看法很明智，普鲁姆，而且无可辩驳。如果移动到北部冰川可以让我们更加安全，那我们就走吧。
changes.key: THATCH: This is a wise point, Plume, and eloquently made. If moving to the northern glacier will keep us safer, then that is what we should do.

changes.english: PLUME: I believe we should migrate to the North glacier.
changes.previous: PLUME: I believe we should migrate to the northern glacier.
changes.chinese: 普鲁姆：我相信我们应该往北部冰川迁徙。
changes.key: PLUME: I believe we should migrate to the northern glacier.

changes.english: THATCH: Building beneath the crust again would shelter us from the volcanic moon's eruptions.
changes.previous: THATCH: Building beneath the crust again would shelter us from the volcanic moon’s eruptions.
changes.chinese: 萨奇：再次在地壳下方进行建造可以保护我们免除火山卫星喷发的危险。
changes.key: THATCH: Building beneath the crust again would shelter us from the volcanic moon’s eruptions.

changes.english: FILIX: What if we used gravity crystals to craft a stable path?
changes.previous: FILIX: What if we use gravity crystals to craft a stable path?
changes.chinese: 费利克斯：我们用重力水晶制造一条稳定的道路如何？
changes.key: FILIX: What if we use gravity crystals to craft a stable path?

changes.english: ILEX: Why We Should Build A New Vessel
changes.previous: ILEX: Why We Should Build A New Vessel
changes.chinese: 艾莱克斯：我们为什么要建造一艘新的飞船
changes.key: ILEX: Why We Should Build A New Vessel

changes.english: ILEX: Each Nomai clan explores the universe in its own Vessel. The Vessel is in the heart of every clan.
changes.previous: ILEX: Each Nomai clan explores the universe in its own Vessel. The Vessel is the heart of every clan.
changes.chinese: 艾莱克斯：所有挪麦家族都会乘坐自己的飞船来探索宇宙。飞船是每一个家族的核心。
changes.key: ILEX: Each Nomai clan explores the universe in its own Vessel. The Vessel is the heart of every clan.

changes.english: ILEX: It's unusual for Nomai to remain in one place for so long. Nomai are wanderers and have no permanent home.
changes.previous: ILEX: It’s unusual for Nomai to remain in one place for so long. Nomai are wanderers and have no permanent home.
changes.chinese: 艾莱克斯：挪麦人在一个地方逗留这么长时间是很不寻常的。挪麦人都是漫游者，居无定所。
changes.key: ILEX: It’s unusual for Nomai to remain in one place for so long. Nomai are wanderers and have no permanent home.

changes.english: ILEX: If we built a new Vessel we could return to our adventurous way of life. Imagine all the new places we could go! Our clan wouldn't be stuck here in this star system.
changes.previous: ILEX: If we built a new Vessel, we could return to our adventurous way of life. Imagine all the new places we could go! Our clan wouldn’t be stuck here in this star system.
changes.chinese: 艾莱克斯：如果我们建造一艘新的飞船，就可以重归冒险生活。想想看，我们将会前往哪些新的地方！我们的家族是不会被困在在这个星系里的。
changes.key: ILEX: If we built a new Vessel, we could return to our adventurous way of life. Imagine all the new places we could go! Our clan wouldn’t be stuck here in this star system.

changes.english: ILEX: We could even meet with other Nomai, and learn from them, like Coleus says we used to do.
changes.previous: ILEX: We could even meet with other Nomai, and learn from them, like Coleus says we used to do.
changes.chinese: 艾莱克斯：我们还能和其他挪麦人见面，学习他们掌握的知识。我们以前就是这样做的，就像科利耶斯说得那样。
changes.key: ILEX: We could even meet with other Nomai, and learn from them, like Coleus says we used to do.

changes.english: ILEX: It probably wouldn't be hard to get parts if we stopped building other new things, and if we broke down other structures (like the towers on Ash Twin) for parts.
changes.previous: ILEX: It probably wouldn’t be hard to get parts if we stopped building other new things, and if we broke down other structures (like the towers on Ash Twin) for parts.
changes.chinese: 艾莱克斯：假如我们别再建造其它的新东西，并且把其它建筑拆掉（比如灰烬双星上的那些高塔），说不定就不愁弄不到零件了。
changes.key: ILEX: It probably wouldn’t be hard to get parts if we stopped building other new things, and if we broke down other structures (like the towers on Ash Twin) for parts.

changes.english: ILEX: We could even have a warp core for jumping long distances like Vessels have. Poke tells me she plans to make a very advanced warp core for a different project. I'm sure she could connect it to the Vessel for travel (because Poke is smart).
changes.previous: ILEX: We could even have a warp core for jumping long distances like Vessels have. Poke tells me she plans to make a very advanced warp core for a different project. I’m sure she could connect it to the Vessel for travel (because Poke is smart).
changes.chinese: 艾莱克斯：我们还有一颗可以进行远距离跳跃的跃迁核心，就像飞船上的核心那样。珀克告诉我，她打算为其它计划制造一颗非常高级的跃迁核心。我肯定她可以把核心和飞船进行连接，用它来航行（因为珀克很聪明）。
changes.key: ILEX: We could even have a warp core for jumping long distances like Vessels have. Poke tells me she plans to make a very advanced warp core for a different project. I’m sure she could connect it to the Vessel for travel (because Poke is smart).

changes.english: ILEX: We might have to build a smaller Vessel for now, even though Vessels are normally large. But we could make it bigger later once we reach planets with more resources.
changes.previous: ILEX: We might have to build a smaller Vessel for now, even though Vessels are normally large. But we could make it bigger later once we reach planets with more resources.
changes.chinese: 艾莱克斯：我们目前也许只能建造一艘小一点的飞船。虽然一般来说飞船都很大。但是我们可以在抵达其它资源更多的行星时，再把飞船造得更大。
changes.key: ILEX: We might have to build a smaller Vessel for now, even though Vessels are normally large. But we could make it bigger later once we reach planets with more resources.

changes.english: ILEX: It would also help if we stopped building so many things to search for the Eye of the universe. I asked Yarrow, and he says we use lots of resources on the Ash Twin Project.
changes.previous: ILEX: It would also help if we stopped building so many things to search for the Eye of the universe. I asked Yarrow, and he says we use lots of resources on the Ash Twin Project.
changes.chinese: 艾莱克斯：如果我们不再造那么多东西去寻找宇宙之眼就好了。我问过亚罗，他说我们在灰烬双星计划上投入了许多资源。
changes.key: ILEX: It would also help if we stopped building so many things to search for the Eye of the universe. I asked Yarrow, and he says we use lots of resources on the Ash Twin Project.

changes.english: Solution 1: We could retrieve the warp core from the Vessel.
changes.previous: Solution 1: We could retrieve the warp core from the Vessel.
changes.chinese: 解决方案1：我们可以从飞船上面把跃迁核心回收回来。
changes.key: Solution 1: We could retrieve the warp core from the Vessel.

changes.english: RAMIE: The Vessel’s warp core is broken, at best (recall those present when the Vessel crashed said it sustained lethal injuries). There is no guaranteed reward for this risk.
changes.previous: RAMIE: The Vessel’s warp core is broken, at best (recall those present when the Vessel crashed said it sustained lethal injuries). There is no guaranteed reward for this risk.
changes.chinese: 瑞米：乐观估计，飞船的跃迁核心已经坏了（回想飞船坠落当时所提到的，核心受到了致命的损伤）。这次冒险未必能够得到回报。
changes.key: RAMIE: The Vessel’s warp core is broken, at best (recall those present when the Vessel crashed said it sustained lethal injuries). There is no guaranteed reward for this risk.

changes.english: CASSAVA: Even if it no longer functions, the old core would be a valuable blueprint, provided we're able to transport it back here.
changes.previous: CASSAVA: Even if it no longer functions, the old core could be a valuable blueprint, provided we’re able to transport it back here.
changes.chinese: 卡萨瓦：就算旧核心已经无法工作了，只要我们能够把它给运回来，它依然可以为我们提供宝贵的设计蓝图。
changes.key: CASSAVA: Even if it no longer functions, the old core could be a valuable blueprint, provided we’re able to transport it back here.

changes.english: CONOY: Perhaps we could still repair it. My grandmother told me there was little time to assess the nature or extent of the damage.
changes.previous: CONOY: Perhaps we could still repair it. My grandmother told me there was little time to assess the nature or extent of the damage.
changes.chinese: 科诺伊：也许我们依然应该把它修好。我的祖母告诉过我，没有时间可以去评估损失的性质或者是程度。
changes.key: CONOY: Perhaps we could still repair it. My grandmother told me there was little time to assess the nature or extent of the damage.

changes.english: PHLOX: This would require a return to Dark Bramble. Plume (my father) said many a good Nomai perished there.
changes.previous: PHLOX: This would require a return to Dark Bramble. Plume (my father) said many good Nomai perished there.
changes.chinese: 弗拉克斯：这样我们就得回到黑棘星去。普鲁姆（我的父亲）说过，许多出色的挪麦人都在那里失去了生命。
changes.key: PHLOX: This would require a return to Dark Bramble. Plume (my father) said many good Nomai perished there.

changes.english: CYCAD: My mentor (Coleus) and his old mentor once discovered and studied an anglerfish fossil on Ember Twin. Using that knowledge, we could avoid the anglerfish entirely!
changes.previous: CYCAD: My mentor (Coleus) and his old mentor once discovered and studied an anglerfish fossil on Ember Twin. Using that knowledge, we could avoid the anglerfish entirely!
changes.chinese: 赛卡德：我的导师（科利耶斯）和他从前的导师有一次在余烬双星上发现过一块安康鱼化石，并对其进行了研究。通过这些知识，我们完全可以避开安康鱼！
changes.key: CYCAD: My mentor (Coleus) and his old mentor once discovered and studied an anglerfish fossil on Ember Twin. Using that knowledge, we could avoid the anglerfish entirely!

changes.english: COLEUS: What Melorae and I learned from that fossil would theoretically help us evade the anglerfish, but my hypothesis was never tested on a live specimen.
changes.previous: COLEUS: What Melorae and I learned from that fossil would theoretically help us evade the anglerfish, but our hypothesis was never tested on a live specimen.
changes.chinese: 科利耶斯：从理论上来讲，梅洛瑞和我从化石上了解到的内容可以帮助我们躲避安康鱼，但我们的假设从来没有在活体标本上进行过验证。
changes.key: COLEUS: What Melorae and I learned from that fossil would theoretically help us evade the anglerfish, but our hypothesis was never tested on a live specimen.

changes.english: RAMIE: I remember that anglerfish fossil! We used to play in Fossil Fish Cave when we were children.
changes.previous: RAMIE: I remember that anglerfish fossil! We used to play in Fossil Fish Cave when we were children.
changes.chinese: 瑞米：我记得那块安康鱼化石！我们小的时候曾经在化石鱼洞里面玩过游戏。
changes.key: RAMIE: I remember that anglerfish fossil! We used to play in Fossil Fish Cave when we were children.

changes.english: SOLANUM: I no longer believe, as I did as a child on Ember Twin, that the Eye of the universe (the source of the signal) wishes to harm us. But it may not want to be found, either.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: I no longer believe, as I did as a child on Ember Twin, that the Eye of the universe (the source of the signal) wishes to harm us. But it may not want to be found, either.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：小时候在余烬双星上，我一直认为宇宙之眼（那个信号的源头）想要害我们。现在我已经改变了这个想法。不过也许它也不希望被别人找到。
changes.key: SOLANUM: I no longer believe, as I did as a child on Ember Twin, that the Eye of the universe (the source of the signal) wishes to harm us. But it may not want to be found, either.

changes.english: SOLANUM: In fact, the Eye may not have wishes at all. We have no evidence supporting this.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: In fact, the Eye may not have wishes at all. We have no evidence supporting this.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：事实上，眼很可能根本没有自己的意愿。我们并不具备支持这一说法的证据。
changes.key: SOLANUM: In fact, the Eye may not have wishes at all. We have no evidence supporting this.

changes.english: SOLANUM: The terrible circumstances of our arrival here were almost certainly exactly that: Circumstance.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: The terrible circumstances of our arrival here were almost certainly exactly that: circumstance.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：我们来到这里所遭遇的艰苦环境几乎就说明了这一点。
changes.key: SOLANUM: The terrible circumstances of our arrival here were almost certainly exactly that: circumstance.

changes.english: SOLANUM: I suspect imagining we are special to the eye in some way is wishful thinking. The Eye might have called out to any sentient species.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: I suspect imagining we are special to the Eye in some way is wishful thinking. The Eye might have called out to any sentient species.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：我们觉得自己对于眼来说是特别的存在。我猜测这种想法不过是一厢情愿。眼可能在对任何一个智能物种发出呼唤。
changes.key: SOLANUM: I suspect imagining we are special to the Eye in some way is wishful thinking. The Eye might have called out to any sentient species.

changes.english: SOLANUM: Or it might not have been calling out at all, and that my ancestors heard the Eye's signal holds no great, deep meaning.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: Or it might not have been calling out at all, and that my ancestors heard the Eye’s signal holds no great, deep meaning.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：也可能它根本没有在进行呼唤，我的祖先听到的眼信号并没有什么深刻的含义。
changes.key: SOLANUM: Or it might not have been calling out at all, and that my ancestors heard the Eye’s signal holds no great, deep meaning.

changes.english: SOLANUM: This wouldn't be so bad, I think.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: This wouldn’t be so bad, I think.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：我想，这也不算是什么坏事。
changes.key: SOLANUM: This wouldn’t be so bad, I think.

changes.english: Be welcomed in this place. This shrine is a space to reflect on what brought us here to this star system: The signal from the Eye.
changes.previous: Be welcomed in this place. This shrine is a space to reflect on what brought us to this star system: the signal from the Eye.
changes.chinese: 欢迎来到这个地方。来自眼的信号把我们带到了这个星系。我们在这个祭坛里对这一现象进行思考。
changes.key: Be welcomed in this place. This shrine is a space to reflect on what brought us to this star system: the signal from the Eye.

changes.english: We observed the Eye's signal in our travels, and followed it here to find its source.
changes.previous: We observed the Eye’s signal in our travels, and followed it here to find its source.
changes.chinese: 我们在旅途中观察到了眼的信号，于是跟着它来到这里，想要寻找信号的来源。
changes.key: We observed the Eye’s signal in our travels, and followed it here to find its source.

changes.english: What we know is this: The source of the signal (which we have chosen to call the Eye of the universe) is older than the universe itself. The rest, we have yet to learn.
changes.previous: What we know is this: The source of the signal (which we have chosen to call the Eye of the universe) is older than this universe itself. The rest, we have yet to learn.
changes.chinese: 我们所知的情况如下：信号的来源（我们称之为宇宙之眼）比这个宇宙本身还要古老。别的我们就不知道了。
changes.key: What we know is this: The source of the signal (which we have chosen to call the Eye of the universe) is older than this universe itself. The rest, we have yet to learn.

changes.english: Enter, and open your mind to its possibilities.
changes.previous: Enter, and open your mind to its possibilities.
changes.chinese: 进入祭坛，在它的各种可能性面前，开放你的头脑。
changes.key: Enter, and open your mind to its possibilities.

changes.english: What is the Eye of the universe?
changes.previous: What is the Eye of the universe?
changes.chinese: 什么是宇宙之眼？
changes.key: What is the Eye of the universe?

changes.english: The Eye is the source of the signal that brought us here.
changes.previous: The Eye is the source of the signal that brought us here.
changes.chinese: 是眼发出的信号带我们来到了这里。
changes.key: The Eye is the source of the signal that brought us here.

changes.english: Suppose the Eye is a more advanced being.
changes.previous: Suppose the Eye is a more advanced being.
changes.chinese: 估计眼是一个更加高级的存在。
changes.key: Suppose the Eye is a more advanced being.

changes.english: The Eye is older than the universe, so imagine how much it could teach us.
changes.previous: The Eye is older than this universe, so imagine how much it could teach us.
changes.chinese: 眼比这个宇宙本身还要古老。想想看，我们能从它那里学到多少知识。
changes.key: The Eye is older than this universe, so imagine how much it could teach us.

changes.english: Perhaps it is a cosmic library!
changes.previous: Perhaps it is a cosmic library!
changes.chinese: 说不定它就是一座宇宙图书馆！
changes.key: Perhaps it is a cosmic library!

changes.english: What sets the eyes signal?
changes.previous: What is the Eye’s signal?
changes.chinese: 眼的信号到底是什么？
changes.key: What is the Eye’s signal?

changes.english: Of note: From the signal, we were able to determine the Eye’s approximate age (or perhaps its lack of age?)
changes.previous: Of note: From the signal, we were able to determine the Eye’s approximate age (or perhaps its lack of age?).
changes.chinese: 注意事项：我们根据信号可以推断出眼的大致年龄（或者应该说，它缺少的那部分年龄？）。
changes.key: Of note: From the signal, we were able to determine the Eye’s approximate age (or perhaps its lack of age?).

changes.english: Suppose the Eye wishes to communicate.
changes.previous: Suppose the Eye wishes to communicate.
changes.chinese: 估计眼想要进行交流。
changes.key: Suppose the Eye wishes to communicate.

changes.english: The signal is a call. Were we the intended audience?
changes.previous: The signal is a call. Were we the intended audience?
changes.chinese: 那个信号在进行呼唤。是在呼唤我们吗？
changes.key: The signal is a call. Were we the intended audience?

changes.english: The signal is the Eye's voice. It speaks a language we don't yet know.
changes.previous: The signal is the Eye’s voice. It speaks a language we don’t yet know.
changes.chinese: 那个信号是眼在说话。它说着我们尚且无法理解的语言。
changes.key: The signal is the Eye’s voice. It speaks a language we don’t yet know.

changes.english: Or maybe the signal is the Eye's attempt at expressing itself.
changes.previous: Or maybe the signal is the Eye’s attempt at expressing itself.
changes.chinese: 或许那个信号是眼想要表达自己。
changes.key: Or maybe the signal is the Eye’s attempt at expressing itself.

changes.english: POKE: Clary and Root, kindly tune the alignments on each black hole core as I finish them. The schematic on the floor shows which warp tower aligns with which astral body.
changes.previous: POKE: Clary and Root, kindly tune the alignments on each black hole core as I finish them. The schematic on the floor shows which warp tower aligns with which astral body.
changes.chinese: 珀克：克莱瑞还有鲁特，请在我完成黑洞核心的时候，对每一颗核心进行校准调节。哪座跃迁塔和哪个天体匹配，都画在地上的图示里了。
changes.key: POKE: Clary and Root, kindly tune the alignments on each black hole core as I finish them. The schematic on the floor shows which warp tower aligns with which astral body.

changes.english: CLARY: To speed future deliveries to Ash Twin, I've tuned the first black hole core to activate when it's warp tower aligns along with Brittle Hollow.
changes.previous: CLARY: To speed future deliveries to Ash Twin, I’ve tuned the first black hole core to activate when its warp tower aligns with Brittle Hollow.
changes.chinese: 克莱瑞：为了以后能更快捷地到达灰烬双星，我已经调整好了第一颗黑洞核心，把它设为在跃迁塔对准碎空星时启动。
changes.key: CLARY: To speed future deliveries to Ash Twin, I’ve tuned the first black hole core to activate when its warp tower aligns with Brittle Hollow.

changes.english: CLARY: And before anyone comments, *yes*, I am aware this reduces the distance between Yarrow and me.
changes.previous: CLARY: And before anyone comments, yes, I am aware this reduces the distance between Yarrow and me.
changes.chinese: 克莱瑞：不用你们说，没错，我注意到了：如此一来，亚罗和我之间的距离将会大大缩减。
changes.key: CLARY: And before anyone comments, yes, I am aware this reduces the distance between Yarrow and me.

changes.english: ROOT: This schematic shows the six towers on Ash Twin being tuned to only five alignments. Is that a mistake?
changes.previous: ROOT: The schematic shows the six towers on Ash Twin are being tuned to only five alignments. Is that a mistake?
changes.chinese: 鲁特：根据图示，灰烬双星的六座跃迁塔只匹配了五个天体。是哪里出错了吗？
changes.key: ROOT: The schematic shows the six towers on Ash Twin are being tuned to only five alignments. Is that a mistake?

changes.english: POKE: No, that's correct. For these alignments we've decided to treat the Hourglass Twins as a single astral body.
changes.previous: POKE: No, that’s correct. For these alignments we've decided to treat the Hourglass Twins as a single astral body.
changes.chinese: 珀克：不，没有错。匹配跃迁塔时，我们得把沙漏双星看作一个天体。
changes.key: POKE: No, that’s correct. For these alignments we've decided to treat the Hourglass Twins as a single astral body.

changes.english: POKE: If it helps, you can imagine the Hourglass Twins as aligning with themselves.
changes.previous: POKE: If it helps, you can imagine the Hourglass Twins as aligning with themselves.
changes.chinese: 珀克：你可以这样理解，沙漏双星之间算是相互匹配的。
changes.key: POKE: If it helps, you can imagine the Hourglass Twins as aligning with themselves.

changes.english: POKE: Have you seen Phlox's tower designs in the High Energy Lab on Ember Twin? They clarify each tower's warp destination.
changes.previous: POKE: Have you seen Phlox’s tower designs in the High Energy Lab on Ember Twin? They clarify each tower’s warp destination.
changes.chinese: 珀克：你有没有去余烬双星上的高能实验室看过弗拉克斯的跃迁塔设计图？每座塔的跃迁目的地都已经标明在上面了。
changes.key: POKE: Have you seen Phlox’s tower designs in the High Energy Lab on Ember Twin? They clarify each tower’s warp destination.

changes.english: FILIX: Has anyone observed the phantom moon that sometimes greets us in the night sky? Your thoughts interest me.
changes.previous: FILIX: Has anyone observed the phantom moon that sometimes greets us in the night sky? Your thoughts interest me.
changes.chinese: 费利克斯：有谁观察过偶尔在夜空中露面的幻影卫星？我愿意听一听你们的想法。
changes.key: FILIX: Has anyone observed the phantom moon that sometimes greets us in the night sky? Your thoughts interest me.

changes.english: THATCH: I compliment your eyes! How do you imagine it disappears? Hypothesis: Could it be a shift in the light spectrum?
changes.previous: THATCH: I compliment your eyes! How do you imagine it disappears? Hypothesis: Could it be a shift in the light spectrum?
changes.chinese: 萨奇：你的眼神可真是厉害！你对它的消失怎么认为？假设：会不会是光谱偏移导致的？
changes.key: THATCH: I compliment your eyes! How do you imagine it disappears? Hypothesis: Could it be a shift in the light spectrum?

changes.english: PLUME: Suppose this moon is too shy to show us its face.
changes.previous: PLUME: Suppose this moon is too shy to show us its face.
changes.chinese: 普鲁姆：估计这颗卫星太害羞，不敢把自己的脸露出来。
changes.key: PLUME: Suppose this moon is too shy to show us its face.

changes.english: PLUME: I'm interested in your playful moon. Is it much like it's violent friend (Hollow’s Lantern)?
changes.previous: PLUME: I’m interested in your playful moon. Is it much like its violent friend (Hollow’s Lantern)?
changes.chinese: 普鲁姆：我对这颗调皮的卫星很感兴趣。它像不像它的那颗颜色鲜艳的朋友（空心灯）？
changes.key: PLUME: I’m interested in your playful moon. Is it much like its violent friend (Hollow’s Lantern)?

changes.english: FILIX: This moon isn’t volcanic (to my unaided eyes). Sometimes it leaves its friend Hollow’s Lantern for nights at a time.
changes.previous: FILIX: This moon isn’t volcanic (to my unaided eyes). Sometimes it leaves its friend Hollow’s Lantern for nights at a time.
changes.chinese: 费利克斯：这不是一颗火山卫星（在我的肉眼看来）。有时它会一下子把它的朋友空心灯丢下，长达好几个晚上。
changes.key: FILIX: This moon isn’t volcanic (to my unaided eyes). Sometimes it leaves its friend Hollow’s Lantern for nights at a time.

changes.english: PLUME: The nights the moon circles this planet appear random. It seems to travel as it likes.
changes.previous: PLUME: The nights the moon circles this planet appear random. It seems to travel as it likes.
changes.chinese: 普鲁姆：卫星貌似是随机出现在这颗行星的夜空中的。好像它想去哪儿就去哪儿。
changes.key: PLUME: The nights the moon circles this planet appear random. It seems to travel as it likes.

changes.english: THATCH: Imagine if there were *two* volcanic moons.
changes.previous: THATCH: Imagine if there were two volcanic moons.
changes.chinese: 萨奇：想想看，万一它们是2颗火山卫星呢？
changes.key: THATCH: Imagine if there were two volcanic moons.

changes.english: PLUME: Then I imagine there'd be none of us left!
changes.previous: PLUME: Then I imagine there’d be none of us left!
changes.chinese: 普鲁姆：那我想咱们就都活不成了！
changes.key: PLUME: Then I imagine there’d be none of us left!

changes.english: FILIX: Hypothesis: There can exist too much lava.
changes.previous: FILIX: Hypothesis: There can exist too much lava.
changes.chinese: 费利克斯：假设：上面可能会有过多的岩浆。
changes.key: FILIX: Hypothesis: There can exist too much lava.

changes.english: THATCH: I'd strongly prefer we test the null hypothesis.
changes.previous: THATCH: I’d strongly prefer we test the null hypothesis.
changes.chinese: 萨奇：我强烈建议我们证明一下这种假设是错误的。
changes.key: THATCH: I’d strongly prefer we test the null hypothesis.

changes.english: CLARY: To our friends on Brittle Hollow: I just warped here from the White Hole Station (on the other side of Brittle Hollow’s black hole)! Our design worked; we've successfully recreated warp travel!
changes.previous: CLARY: To our friends on Brittle Hollow: I just warped here from the White Hole Station (on the other side of Brittle Hollow’s black hole)! Our design worked; we’ve successfully recreated warp travel!
changes.chinese: 克莱瑞：给我们在碎空星上的朋友们：我刚刚从白洞站（碎空星黑洞的另一头）跃迁到了这里！我们的设计方案起作用了；我们成功地再现了跃迁旅行！
changes.key: CLARY: To our friends on Brittle Hollow: I just warped here from the White Hole Station (on the other side of Brittle Hollow’s black hole)! Our design worked; we’ve successfully recreated warp travel!

changes.english: FILIX: This is wonderful news! I can't wait to see the warp tower (although it's been a long time since I've jumped through a black hole!
changes.previous: FILIX: This is wonderful news! I can’t wait to see the warp tower (although it’s been a long time since I’ve jumped through a black hole!).
changes.chinese: 费利克斯：这真是天大的好消息！我迫不及待地想要看看跃迁塔的样子（虽然我上次穿越黑洞已经是很久以前的事情了！）。
changes.key: FILIX: This is wonderful news! I can’t wait to see the warp tower (although it’s been a long time since I’ve jumped through a black hole!).

changes.english: POKE: I don't know how close I was to Annona's original design, but as long as what we've built works, then I'm delighted! I knew we could do it (Cassava, I hope you're reading this)!
changes.previous: POKE: I don’t know how close it is to Annona’s original design, but as long as what we’ve built works, then I’m delighted! I knew we could do it (Cassava, I hope you’re reading this)!
changes.chinese: 珀克：我不知道它和安诺纳的原版设计有多大的差别，不过只要能管用，那我就很高兴！我就知道我们能成功（卡萨瓦，但愿你正在看）！
changes.key: POKE: I don’t know how close it is to Annona’s original design, but as long as what we’ve built works, then I’m delighted! I knew we could do it (Cassava, I hope you’re reading this)!

changes.english: POKE: Wait, this can't be correct. Clary, have you seen these readings? If they were accurate, they would violate causality. There must be an equipment error somewhere.
changes.previous: POKE: Wait, this can’t be correct. Clary, have you seen these readings? If they were accurate, they would violate causality. There must be an equipment error somewhere.
changes.chinese: 珀克：等等，这不可能。克莱瑞，你看到这些读数了吗？如果读数正确，那么它们就违反了因果律。一定是有什么地方的设备出现了问题。
changes.key: POKE: Wait, this can’t be correct. Clary, have you seen these readings? If they were accurate, they would violate causality. There must be an equipment error somewhere.

changes.english: POKE: I'm returning to the White Hole Station. If you and Root meet me there, we can run a full diagnostic and hopefully locate the problem.
changes.previous: POKE: I’m returning to the White Hole Station. If you and Root meet me there, we can run a full diagnostic and hopefully locate the problem.
changes.chinese: 珀克：我正在返回白洞站。如果你和鲁特去那里找我，我们可以进行一次全面诊断，希望能够把问题给找出来。
changes.key: POKE: I’m returning to the White Hole Station. If you and Root meet me there, we can run a full diagnostic and hopefully locate the problem.

changes.english: POKE: (don't tell Cassava.)
changes.previous: POKE: (Don’t tell Cassava.)
changes.chinese: 珀克：（别告诉卡萨瓦。）
changes.key: POKE: (Don’t tell Cassava.)

changes.english: PYE: Ramie and I reviewed the records you sent, Poke, and they appear to show the Nomai are arriving at the warp receiver on Brittle Hollow slightly *before* departing from the White Hole Station.
changes.previous: PYE: Ramie and I reviewed the records you sent, Poke, and they appear to show Nomai are arriving at the warp receiver on Brittle Hollow slightly before departing from the White Hole Station.
changes.chinese: 派伊：瑞米和我查看了你送来的记录，珀克，貌似挪麦人抵达碎空星跃迁接收点的时间比离开白洞站的时间要稍微早那么一点点。
changes.key: PYE: Ramie and I reviewed the records you sent, Poke, and they appear to show Nomai are arriving at the warp receiver on Brittle Hollow slightly before departing from the White Hole Station.

changes.english: POKE: I understand it’s exceedingly odd, but Clary and I have tested and retested the equipment, and the result is the same every time someone warps.
changes.previous: POKE: I understand it’s exceedingly odd, but Clary and I have tested and retested the equipment, and the result is the same every time someone warps.
changes.chinese: 珀克：我明白这一现象极为奇怪，但是克莱瑞和我已经一次次地对设备进行过了测试，每一次的跃迁结果都是一样的。
changes.key: POKE: I understand it’s exceedingly odd, but Clary and I have tested and retested the equipment, and the result is the same every time someone warps.

changes.english: RAMIE: The interval is incredibly miniscule (roughly one hundred-thousandth of a second). Do you suppose our instruments can’t accurately measure time to such a small degree?
changes.previous: RAMIE: The interval is incredibly minuscule (roughly one hundred-thousandth of a second). Do you suppose our instruments can’t accurately measure time to such a small degree?
changes.chinese: 瑞米：其时间间隔异常微小（大约只有十万分之一秒）。你是否认为我们的仪器无法精确测量尺度如此微观的时间量？
changes.key: RAMIE: The interval is incredibly miniscule (roughly one hundred-thousandth of a second). Do you suppose our instruments can’t accurately measure time to such a small degree?

changes.english: PYE: As I’ve already told Ramie, these measurements can’t be accurate. How can a Nomai arrive on Brittle Hollow before he or she ever stepped into the teleporter? The implications are absurd.
changes.previous: PYE: As I’ve already told Ramie, these measurements can’t be accurate. How can a Nomai arrive on Brittle Hollow before he or she ever stepped into the teleporter? The implications are absurd.
changes.chinese: 派伊：就像我对瑞米说过得那样，这些测量结果不可能精确。挪麦人怎么可能在踏上传送器之前，就已经抵达碎空星了呢？这其中的逻辑关系太荒谬了。
changes.key: PYE: As I’ve already told Ramie, these measurements can’t be accurate. How can a Nomai arrive on Brittle Hollow before he or she ever stepped into the teleporter? The implications are absurd.

changes.english: POKE: I don’t disagree. It *would* mean I’ve inadvertently broken several fundamental theories regarding this universe. We would have to reconsider all of our beliefs about the nature of time.
changes.previous: POKE: I don’t disagree. It would mean I’ve inadvertently broken several fundamental theories regarding this universe. We would have to reconsider all of our beliefs about the nature of time.
changes.chinese: 珀克：我不同意。这可能意味着我不小心打破了这个宇宙的几个基本理论。我们应该重新考虑一下我们所有与时间本质有关的认知。
changes.key: POKE: I don’t disagree. It would mean I’ve inadvertently broken several fundamental theories regarding this universe. We would have to reconsider all of our beliefs about the nature of time.

changes.english: RAMIE: Yes, I hope so, too!
changes.previous: RAMIE: Yes, I hope so, too!
changes.chinese: 瑞米：没错，我也是这么认为的！
changes.key: RAMIE: Yes, I hope so, too!

changes.english: RAMIE: Poke, as Pye is confident the reading is inaccurate, she’s kindly helping me attempt to recreate this phenomenon at the High Energy Lab. We’re designing an experiment to take more data.
changes.previous: RAMIE: Poke, as Pye is confident the reading is inaccurate, she’s kindly helping me attempt to recreate this phenomenon at the High Energy Lab. We’re designing an experiment to take more data.
changes.chinese: 瑞米：珀克，派伊坚信读数不准确，她好心要帮我在高能实验室试着再现这一现象。我们正在设计一次实验，来获取更多数据。
changes.key: RAMIE: Poke, as Pye is confident the reading is inaccurate, she’s kindly helping me attempt to recreate this phenomenon at the High Energy Lab. We’re designing an experiment to take more data.

changes.english: PYE: An update: Poke, the High Energy Lab is in the canyon on Ember Twin’s equator. *Come here at once*. You need to see this.
changes.previous: PYE: An update: Poke, the High Energy Lab is in the canyon on Ember Twin’s equator. Come here at once. You need to see this.
changes.chinese: 派伊：更新：珀克，高能实验室位于余烬双星赤道的峡谷里。立刻过来。你得瞧瞧这个。
changes.key: PYE: An update: Poke, the High Energy Lab is in the canyon on Ember Twin’s equator. Come here at once. You need to see this.

changes.english: CONOY: What have we learned thus far in our search for the Eye of the universe?
changes.previous: CONOY: What have we learned thus far in our search for the Eye of the universe?
changes.chinese: 科诺伊：到目前为止，寻找宇宙之眼让我们了解到了哪些情况？
changes.key: CONOY: What have we learned thus far in our search for the Eye of the universe?

changes.english: MALLOW: Based on our knowledge of the Quantum Moon, we believe the Eye is in orbit around this star system's sun. This would mean the Eye is located within a finite (albeit enormous) range.
changes.previous: MALLOW: Based on our knowledge of the Quantum Moon, we believe the Eye is in orbit around this star system’s sun. This would mean the Eye is located within a finite (albeit enormous) range.
changes.chinese: 玛罗：基于我们对量子卫星的了解，我们相信眼处在环绕该星系的太阳轨道上。也就是说眼位于有限（虽然范围异常之大）的距离之内。
changes.key: MALLOW: Based on our knowledge of the Quantum Moon, we believe the Eye is in orbit around this star system’s sun. This would mean the Eye is located within a finite (albeit enormous) range.

changes.english: PLUME: Those of us on the Vessel originally followed the Eye’s signal to this star system, but we were unable to warp to the Eye itself.
changes.previous: PLUME: Those of us on the Vessel originally followed the Eye’s signal to this star system, but we were unable to warp to the Eye itself.
changes.chinese: 普鲁姆：我们在飞船上的那些人最初跟着眼的信号来到了这个星系，但是我们无法跃迁到眼那里去。
changes.key: PLUME: Those of us on the Vessel originally followed the Eye’s signal to this star system, but we were unable to warp to the Eye itself.

changes.english: PRIVET: the locator we built on the Attlerock and the new, more sensitive locator we built here were both unable to detect any trace of the Eye’s signal.
changes.previous: PRIVET: The locator we built on the Attlerock and the new, more sensitive locator we built here were both unable to detect any trace of the Eye’s signal.
changes.chinese: 普利维特：我们在废岩星上建造的定位器，还有我们在这里新建造的更加灵敏的新型定位器，都无法检测到眼信号的任何踪迹。
changes.key: PRIVET: The locator we built on the Attlerock and the new, more sensitive locator we built here were both unable to detect any trace of the Eye’s signal.

changes.english: AVENS: Hypothesis: The Eye has stopped emitting its signal.
changes.previous: AVENS: Hypothesis: The Eye has stopped emitting its signal.
changes.chinese: 埃文斯：假设：眼不再发射信号了。
changes.key: AVENS: Hypothesis: The Eye has stopped emitting its signal.

changes.english: CASSAVA: Suppose the Eye doesn't wish to be found.
changes.previous: CASSAVA: Suppose the Eye doesn’t wish to be found.
changes.chinese: 卡萨瓦：估计眼不想被别人找到。
changes.key: CASSAVA: Suppose the Eye doesn’t wish to be found.

changes.english: PLUME: Cassava, how can you suggest that? The Eye's signal called out to summon us to this star system!
changes.previous: PLUME: Cassava, how can you suggest that? The Eye’s signal called out to summon us to this star system!
changes.chinese: 普鲁姆：卡萨瓦，你怎么能这么说？是眼的信号召唤我们来到了这个星系！
changes.key: PLUME: Cassava, how can you suggest that? The Eye’s signal called out to summon us to this star system!

changes.english: CASSAVA: I'm aware; I grew up hearing the Eye's story. Yet we're no closer to finding it than you were when you first arrived here.
changes.previous: CASSAVA: I’m aware; I grew up hearing the Eye’s story. Yet we’re no closer to finding it than you were when you first arrived here.
changes.chinese: 卡萨瓦：我知道；我是听着眼的故事长大的。可是和你第一次来到这里一样，我们压根就没法找到它。
changes.key: CASSAVA: I’m aware; I grew up hearing the Eye’s story. Yet we’re no closer to finding it than you were when you first arrived here.

changes.english: CONOY: How should our methods change as we continue our search for the Eye of the universe?
changes.previous: CONOY: How should our methods change as we continue our search for the Eye of the universe?
changes.chinese: 科诺伊：假如要继续寻找宇宙之眼，我们应该改用怎样的搜索方法？
changes.key: CONOY: How should our methods change as we continue our search for the Eye of the universe?

changes.english: PRIVET: As we couldn't find the Eye's signal using two different devices built for this exact purpose, we should discontinue this search method.
changes.previous: PRIVET: As we couldn’t find the Eye’s signal using two different devices built for this exact purpose, we should discontinue this search method.
changes.chinese: 普利维特：两台专门用于寻找眼信号的设备都无法完成任务，我们不应该用这种方式继续找下去。
changes.key: PRIVET: As we couldn’t find the Eye’s signal using two different devices built for this exact purpose, we should discontinue this search method.

changes.english: MALLOW: We know what the Eye looks like thanks to the Quantum Moon, so what if we try to find the Eye visually, instead? Let's send out a probe!
changes.previous: MALLOW: We know what the Eye looks like thanks to the Quantum Moon, so what if we try to find the Eye visually, instead? Let’s send out a probe!
changes.chinese: 玛罗：多亏了量子卫星，我们知道了眼长什么样。那么我们就用肉眼去寻找眼如何？我们来发射一个探测器吧！
changes.key: MALLOW: We know what the Eye looks like thanks to the Quantum Moon, so what if we try to find the Eye visually, instead? Let’s send out a probe!

changes.english: CASSAVA: Mallow's idea is clever, but we have no idea where the Eye is in relation to here. The probability of launching a probe in the right direction would be absurdly small.
changes.previous: CASSAVA: Mallow’s idea is clever, but we have no idea where the Eye is in relation to here. The probability of launching a probe in the correct direction would be absurdly small.
changes.chinese: 卡萨瓦：玛罗的主意很不错，但是我们不知道眼与这里的相对位置。探测器发往正确方向的可能性微乎其微。
changes.key: CASSAVA: Mallow’s idea is clever, but we have no idea where the Eye is in relation to here. The probability of launching a probe in the correct direction would be absurdly small.

changes.english: CONOY: I believe I have a solution to that problem! Have you spoken with Ramie and Pye about the technology they're developing?
changes.previous: CONOY: I believe I have a solution for that problem! Have you spoken with Ramie and Pye about the technology they’re developing?
changes.chinese: 科诺伊：我相信我有一个解决方法！你和瑞米以及派伊谈过他们正在开发的技术吗？
changes.key: CONOY: I believe I have a solution for that problem! Have you spoken with Ramie and Pye about the technology they’re developing?

changes.english: AVENS: We'd need to build a probe-launching mechanism to cover those long distances quickly. A cannon in orbit around a celestial body would circumvent the need to escape gravity's pull.
changes.previous: AVENS: We’d need to build a probe-launching mechanism to cover those long distances quickly. A cannon in orbit around a celestial body would circumvent the need to escape gravity’s pull.
changes.chinese: 埃文斯：我们需要建造一个发射装置，能够迅速地把探测器发射到如此远的距离去。在某个天体轨道上设置一门大炮应该可以摆脱重力的束缚。
changes.key: AVENS: We’d need to build a probe-launching mechanism to cover those long distances quickly. A cannon in orbit around a celestial body would circumvent the need to escape gravity’s pull.

changes.english: CASSAVA: Giant’s Deep would be a good choice. It's furthest from the sun, so it would provide the best angles for launch. And it's moonless (except for when the Quantum Moon is visiting).
changes.previous: CASSAVA: Giant’s Deep would be a good choice. It’s furthest from the sun, so it would provide the best angles for launch. And it’s moonless (except when the Quantum Moon is visiting).
changes.chinese: 卡萨瓦：深巨星是个不错的选择。它距离太阳最远，因此可以提供最佳的发射角度。而且它没有卫星（除非量子卫星来访）。
changes.key: CASSAVA: Giant’s Deep would be a good choice. It’s furthest from the sun, so it would provide the best angles for launch. And it’s moonless (except when the Quantum Moon is visiting).

changes.english: AVENS: Yes, let's build the cannon in orbit around Giant’s Deep!
changes.previous: AVENS: Yes, let’s build the cannon in orbit around Giant’s Deep!
changes.chinese: 埃文斯：没错，我们就在深巨星的轨道上建造大炮吧！
changes.key: AVENS: Yes, let’s build the cannon in orbit around Giant’s Deep!

changes.english: SOLANUM: I'm at the shuttle! I'm ready to make my first pilgrimage to the Quantum Moon.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: I’m at the shuttle! I’m ready to make my first pilgrimage to the Quantum Moon.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：我坐上了航天飞机！我准备好了。我即将要前往量子卫星，进行首次朝圣。
changes.key: SOLANUM: I’m at the shuttle! I’m ready to make my first pilgrimage to the Quantum Moon.

changes.english: BELLS: That's exciting! You're *almost* ready, but there's still one more rule you need to learn. Come see me at the Tower of Quantum Knowledge.
changes.previous: BELLS: That’s exciting! You’re almost ready, but there’s still one more rule you need to learn. Come see me at the Tower of Quantum Knowledge.
changes.chinese: 贝尔斯：真是叫人激动！你差不多准备好了。不过你还有一条法则需要学习。来量子知识之塔见我。
changes.key: BELLS: That’s exciting! You’re almost ready, but there’s still one more rule you need to learn. Come see me at the Tower of Quantum Knowledge.

changes.english: BELLS: The tower is on the opposite side of Brittle Hollow. If you follow the path to the Crossroads, you can reach the tower from there.
changes.previous: BELLS: The tower is on the opposite side of Brittle Hollow. If you follow the path west to the Crossroads, you can reach the tower from there.
changes.chinese: 贝尔斯：量子知识之塔在碎空星的另一头。如果你沿着西边的路走到十字路口，就能从那儿前往量子知识之塔。
changes.key: BELLS: The tower is on the opposite side of Brittle Hollow. If you follow the path west to the Crossroads, you can reach the tower from there.

changes.english: SOLANUM: My gratitude for the directions, Bells. I'll see you soon!
changes.previous: SOLANUM: My gratitude for the directions, Bells. I’ll see you soon!
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：感谢你为我指路，贝尔斯。我们回头见！
changes.key: SOLANUM: My gratitude for the directions, Bells. I’ll see you soon!

changes.english: SOLANUM: I am here! After watching it wander the skies for so long, I am about to stand (for the first time) on the Quantum Moon.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: I am here! After watching it wander the skies for so long, I am about to stand (for the first time) on the Quantum Moon.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：我到了！一直以来，我都看着量子卫星在天空中流浪。如今我即将（第一次）踏上它的表面。
changes.key: SOLANUM: I am here! After watching it wander the skies for so long, I am about to stand (for the first time) on the Quantum Moon.

changes.english: SOLANUM: As expected, my shuttle has landed at the moon's south pole. I will make the remainder of my journey on foot.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: As expected, my shuttle has landed at the moon’s south pole. I will make the remainder of my journey on foot.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：和预想中一样，我的航天飞机已经降落在了卫星的南极。剩下的路我就步行吧。
changes.key: SOLANUM: As expected, my shuttle has landed at the moon’s south pole. I will make the remainder of my journey on foot.

changes.english: SOLANUM: We don't know why the Quantum Moon always welcomes its visitors at the south pole, just that this is true.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: We don’t know why the Quantum Moon always welcomes its visitors at the south pole, just that this is true.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：不知道为什么，凡是造访量子卫星的人，都会在南极降落。我只知道，这事从来都没有过例外。
changes.key: SOLANUM: We don’t know why the Quantum Moon always welcomes its visitors at the south pole, just that this is true.

changes.english: SOLANUM: As a child, I considered such unknowns sinister. Now though, I understand they bear no ill will. The universe is, and we are.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: As a child, I considered such unknowns sinister. Now, though, I understand they bear no ill will. The universe is, and we are.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：我还小的时候，觉得这种让人无法理解的事情都很可疑。可现在，我明白了，其实谁也没有恶意。宇宙如此，我们也是一样。
changes.key: SOLANUM: As a child, I considered such unknowns sinister. Now, though, I understand they bear no ill will. The universe is, and we are.

changes.english: SOLANUM: I am ready.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: I am ready.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：我准备好了。
changes.key: SOLANUM: I am ready.

changes.english: ROOT: Friends in the Timber Hearth mines, the last type of ore you sent us survives the longest in direct heat.
changes.previous: ROOT: Friends in the Timber Hearth Mines, the last type of ore you sent us survives the longest in direct heat.
changes.chinese: 鲁特：木炉星矿井的各位朋友，你们寄给我们的矿石中，最后一种在直接受热时坚持的时间最长。
changes.key: ROOT: Friends in the Timber Hearth Mines, the last type of ore you sent us survives the longest in direct heat.

changes.english: ROOT: Can you send us more of the same for additional testing? We're attempting to improve its durability, and our forge has already burned through everything you sent!
changes.previous: ROOT: Can you send us more of the same for additional testing? We’re attempting to improve its durability, and our forge has already burned through everything you sent!
changes.chinese: 鲁特：能不能再寄来些这种矿石，好让我们再多做几次实验？我们想把耐久度再提高点，可你们寄来的东西都已经烧光了！
changes.key: ROOT: Can you send us more of the same for additional testing? We’re attempting to improve its durability, and our forge has already burned through everything you sent!

changes.english: OENO: We’ll deliver more ore to Hollow’s Lantern immediately. You must be fired up about crafting the Ash Twin Project’s protective shell!
changes.previous: OENO: We’ll deliver more ore to Hollow’s Lantern immediately. You must be fired up about crafting the Ash Twin Project’s protective shell!
changes.chinese: 奥埃诺：我们将立即把更多矿石寄往空心灯。你们造起这个灰烬双星计划的保护外壳，还真是挺有干劲的嘛！
changes.key: OENO: We’ll deliver more ore to Hollow’s Lantern immediately. You must be fired up about crafting the Ash Twin Project’s protective shell!

changes.english: ROOT: Yes, the idea of an encasement that's supernova-proof, however briefly, has kindled my curiosity!
changes.previous: ROOT: Yes, the idea of an encasement that’s supernova-proof, however briefly, has kindled my curiosity!
changes.chinese: 鲁特：没错！隔绝超新星的保护壳，光是想到这个主意我就够兴奋的了！
changes.key: ROOT: Yes, the idea of an encasement that’s supernova-proof, however briefly, has kindled my curiosity!

changes.english: ROOT: My gratitude! I imagine we'll also have an updated estimate soon of how much ore is needed to seal off the Ash Twin Project.
changes.previous: ROOT: My gratitude! I imagine we’ll also have an updated estimate soon of how much ore is needed to seal off the Ash Twin Project.
changes.chinese: 鲁特：太感谢了！那么，关于完成灰烬双星计划所需的具体矿石数量，想必近期就能向你们提供最新的估测结果。
changes.key: ROOT: My gratitude! I imagine we’ll also have an updated estimate soon of how much ore is needed to seal off the Ash Twin Project.

changes.english: OENO: will it be more than we initially thought?
changes.previous: OENO: Will it be more than we initially thought?
changes.chinese: 奥埃诺：会比我们最开始预计的还要多吗？
changes.key: OENO: Will it be more than we initially thought?

changes.english: ROOT: it will be *significantly* more. The smallest cracking or opening in the protective shell would destroy everything.
changes.previous: ROOT: It will be significantly more. The smallest crack or opening in the protective shell would destroy everything.
changes.chinese: 鲁特：多大发了。保护外壳哪怕裂了一丁点，一切努力就都白费了。
changes.key: ROOT: It will be significantly more. The smallest crack or opening in the protective shell would destroy everything.

changes.english: SOLANUM: Is this your first time on the Quantum Moon? It’s my first time here.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: Is this your first time on the Quantum Moon? It’s my first time here.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：你是第一次来到量子卫星吗？我是第一次来。
changes.key: SOLANUM: Is this your first time on the Quantum Moon? It’s my first time here.

changes.english: SOLANUM: If you’ve come looking for answers, I hope you find them.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: If you’ve come here looking for answers, I hope you find them.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：如果你是来寻找答案的，希望你能够如愿以偿。
changes.key: SOLANUM: If you’ve come here looking for answers, I hope you find them.

changes.english: SOLANUM: Suppose you could reach the Eye of the Universe: Would you try to enter it?
changes.previous: SOLANUM: Suppose you could reach the Eye of the universe: Would you try to enter it?
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：假如你能够到达宇宙之眼：你会想办法进去吗？
changes.key: SOLANUM: Suppose you could reach the Eye of the universe: Would you try to enter it?

changes.english: SOLANUM: What do you imagine the effects of a conscious observer might be?
changes.previous: SOLANUM: What do you imagine the effects of a conscious observer might be?
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：你觉得有意识的观察者可能会造成怎样的影响？
changes.key: SOLANUM: What do you imagine the effects of a conscious observer might be?

changes.english: SOLANUM: We do not have much connection, you and I.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: We do not have much connection, you and I.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：你我之间没有太多的共同点。
changes.key: SOLANUM: We do not have much connection, you and I.

changes.english: SOLANUM: Still, this encounter feels special. I hope you won’t mind if I think of you as a friend.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: Still, this encounter feels special. I hope you won’t mind if I think of you as a friend.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：可是，这次相遇依然让我觉得非比寻常。我想把你当成朋友，希望你不要介意。
changes.key: SOLANUM: Still, this encounter feels special. I hope you won’t mind if I think of you as a friend.

changes.english: SOLANUM: I’ve never met with one of your kind before. It’s an honour to speak with you! I particularly admire your four eyes.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: I’ve never met one of your kind before. It’s an honor to speak with you! I particularly admire your four eyes.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：我以前从来没有遇见过你们种族的人。能够和你交谈我十分荣幸！我特别喜欢你的四只眼睛。
changes.key: SOLANUM: I’ve never met one of your kind before. It’s an honor to speak with you! I particularly admire your four eyes.

changes.english: SOLANUM: There are many questions I would ask, if I could comprehend your language. You have my gratitude for understanding mine.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: There are many questions I would ask, if I could comprehend your language. You have my gratitude for understanding mine.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：要是我能够理解你们的语言就好了。我有许多问题想要问。你能够听懂我说的话，我实在是感激不尽。
changes.key: SOLANUM: There are many questions I would ask, if I could comprehend your language. You have my gratitude for understanding mine.

changes.english: SOLANUM: I imagine your purpose here is the same as mine; to learn about and to find the Eye of the Universe.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: I imagine your purpose here is the same as mine: to learn about and to find the Eye of the universe.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：我想你和我的目的一样：来这里了解并寻找宇宙之眼。
changes.key: SOLANUM: I imagine your purpose here is the same as mine: to learn about and to find the Eye of the universe.

changes.english: SOLANUM: I imagine you’ve noticed the Quantum Moon changes in appearance depending on which location it is currently orbiting (for instance, the moon looks quite different when orbiting Giant’s Deep than it does when orbiting the Hourglass Twins).
changes.previous: SOLANUM: I imagine you’ve noticed the Quantum Moon changes in appearance depending on which location it is currently orbiting (for instance, the moon looks quite different when orbiting Giant's Deep than it does when orbiting the Hourglass Twins).
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：我想你已经注意到了，根据量子卫星当前环绕的轨道不同，它的外观也会发生变化（比如说，卫星在环绕深巨星的时候和环绕沙漏双星的时候，样子是完全不一样的）。
changes.key: SOLANUM: I imagine you’ve noticed the Quantum Moon changes in appearance depending on which location it is currently orbiting (for instance, the moon looks quite different when orbiting Giant’s Deep than it does when orbiting the Hourglass Twins).

changes.english: SOLANUM: Because the Quantum Moon clearly changes in its different forms, the Eye (being this moon’s primary location) must be similarly malleable.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: Because the Quantum Moon clearly changes in its different forms, the Eye (being this moon’s primary location) must be similarly malleable.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：因为量子卫星会在不同的形态之间产生变化，那么眼（该卫星的主要运动位置）一定也具备类似的可变性。
changes.key: SOLANUM: Because the Quantum Moon clearly changes in its different forms, the Eye (being this moon’s primary location) must be similarly malleable.

changes.english: From this, we can hypothesize that *the* *Eye* *represents extreme changeability*.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: From this, we can hypothesize that the Eye represents extreme changeability.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：由此，我们可以假设眼将会表现出异常多变的特性。
changes.key: SOLANUM: From this, we can hypothesize that the Eye represents extreme changeability.

changes.english: SOLANUM: Like many of my clan before me, I journeyed here to see the Quantum Moon’s reflection of the Eye. This is the closest any of us have come to seeing the Eye itself.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: Like many of my clan before me, I journeyed here to see the Quantum Moon’s reflection of the Eye. This is the closest any of us have come to seeing the Eye itself.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：我和之前的许多族人一样，来这里想要看看眼在量子卫星上的倒影。这是我们对眼进行的最近一次观察。
changes.key: SOLANUM: Like many of my clan before me, I journeyed here to see the Quantum Moon’s reflection of the Eye. This is the closest any of us have come to seeing the Eye itself.

changes.english: SOLANUM: You may think I’m strange, but I have a hypothesis that I may not be entirely alive. Perhaps my journey has reached its end.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: You may think I’m strange, but I have a hypothesis that I may not be entirely alive. Perhaps my journey has reached its end.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：你可能会觉得我说这话很奇怪，不过我有一个假设，那就是我可能只是部分地活着。也许我的旅程已经走到了终点。
changes.key: SOLANUM: You may think I’m strange, but I have a hypothesis that I may not be entirely alive. Perhaps my journey has reached its end.

changes.english: SOLANUM: This is the Quantum Moon, where we both are standing.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: This is the Quantum Moon, where we both are standing.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：我们所站的地方叫做量子卫星。
changes.key: SOLANUM: This is the Quantum Moon, where we both are standing.

changes.english: SOLANUM: Despite also orbiting other celestial bodies, the Quantum Moon is the Eye of the universe’s moon.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: Despite also orbiting other celestial bodies, the Quantum Moon is the Eye of the universe’s moon.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：量子卫星是宇宙之眼的卫星，但它也会围绕其它天体运动。
changes.key: SOLANUM: Despite also orbiting other celestial bodies, the Quantum Moon is the Eye of the universe’s moon.

changes.english: SOLANUM: Have you encountered a quantum shard on another planet? The shards look the same as the Quantum Moon’s surface does now, while at the Eye.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: Have you encountered a quantum shard on another planet? The shards look the same as the Quantum Moon’s surface does now, while at the Eye.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：你有没有在其它行星上遇到过量子碎片？那些碎片的样子，就和现在量子卫星位于眼时其表面所展现出来的外观一样。
changes.key: SOLANUM: Have you encountered a quantum shard on another planet? The shards look the same as the Quantum Moon’s surface does now, while at the Eye.

changes.english: SOLANUM: From this, we can reasonably infer the Quantum Moon’s natural state is as we see it now, and that the Eye is its primary location.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: From this, we can reasonably infer the Quantum Moon’s natural state is as we see it now, and that the Eye is its primary location.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：借此有理由推断，我们目前看到的就是量子卫星的自然状态。并且眼是它的主要运动位置。
changes.key: SOLANUM: From this, we can reasonably infer the Quantum Moon’s natural state is as we see it now, and that the Eye is its primary location.

changes.english: SOLANUM: Given that the Quantum Moon is the Eye’s moon, it’s likely that any characteristics the moon exhibits are also exhibited by the Eye itself. The Quantum Moon and its shards, for instance, are quantum; thus, the Eye is likely also quantum.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: Given the Quantum Moon is the Eye’s moon, it’s likely that any characteristics the moon exhibits are also exhibited by the Eye itself. The Quantum Moon and its shards, for instance, are quantum; thus, the Eye is likely also quantum.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：鉴于量子卫星是眼的卫星，那么很可能眼也会具备卫星所展现出来的所有特性。比如说，量子卫星及其碎片是量子态的；因此，眼很可能也是量子态的。
changes.key: SOLANUM: Given the Quantum Moon is the Eye’s moon, it’s likely that any characteristics the moon exhibits are also exhibited by the Eye itself. The Quantum Moon and its shards, for instance, are quantum; thus, the Eye is likely also quantum.

changes.english: SOLANUM: Many in my clan believed the Eye called to us for a particular purpose.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: Many in my clan have believed the Eye called to us for a particular purpose.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：我的家族里有许多人相信眼呼叫我们是有特殊原因的。
changes.key: SOLANUM: Many in my clan have believed the Eye called to us for a particular purpose.

changes.english: SOLANUM: When I was a child, I used to believe the Eye was malevolent, to have lured my clan to this star system only to vanish from them so completely.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: When I was a child, I used to believe the Eye was malevolent, to have lured my clan to this star system only to then vanish from them so completely.
