changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：小的时候，我以为眼不怀好意，想把我的家族引到这个星系来，好把我们彻底铲除。
changes.key: SOLANUM: When I was a child, I used to believe the Eye was malevolent, to have lured my clan to this star system only to then vanish from them so completely.

changes.english: SOLANUM: We are orbiting the Eye of the universe now, although we can not see it (only the Quantum Moon’s reflection of it). The Eye is older than the universe, and my clan believes it dwells in an extremely distant orbit around this star system.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: We are orbiting the Eye of the universe now, although we cannot see it (only the Quantum Moon’s reflection of it). The Eye is older than the universe itself, and my clan believes it dwells in an extremely distant orbit around this star system.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：我们现在正在环绕宇宙之眼的轨道上。不过我们无法看见它（只能看见它在量子卫星上的倒影）。眼比宇宙本身还要古老。我的家族认为它处在一个十分遥远的轨道上环绕这个星系。
changes.key: SOLANUM: We are orbiting the Eye of the universe now, although we cannot see it (only the Quantum Moon’s reflection of it). The Eye is older than the universe itself, and my clan believes it dwells in an extremely distant orbit around this star system.

changes.english: SOLANUM: There is fundamental uncertainty throughout the universe. Normally, this uncertainty is only observable on a very small scale. As one approaches the Eye, however, that uncertainty grows enormously.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: There is fundamental uncertainty throughout the universe. Normally, this uncertainty is only observable on a very small scale. As one approaches the Eye, however, that uncertainty grows enormously.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：整个宇宙遍布基础不确定性。一般来说，这种不确定性只能在非常微小的尺度上才能被观察到。但是，当有人接近眼的时候，它就会急剧放大。
changes.key: SOLANUM: There is fundamental uncertainty throughout the universe. Normally, this uncertainty is only observable on a very small scale. As one approaches the Eye, however, that uncertainty grows enormously.

changes.english: SOLANUM: The Quantum Moon probably exhibits macroscopic quantum behaviour because of its proximity to the Eye. Shards that broke off from the Quantum Moon have a similar effect, as I imagine you’ve seen elsewhere in this star system.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: The Quantum Moon probably exhibits macroscopic quantum behavior because of its proximity to the Eye. Shards that broke off from the Quantum Moon have a similar effect, as I imagine you’ve seen elsewhere in this star system.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：量子卫星很可能是因为接近眼，所以才在宏观尺度上表现出了量子行为。从量子卫星上分离出来的碎片拥有类似的特性。我想你已经在这个星系的其它地方见到过了。
changes.key: SOLANUM: The Quantum Moon probably exhibits macroscopic quantum behavior because of its proximity to the Eye. Shards that broke off from the Quantum Moon have a similar effect, as I imagine you’ve seen elsewhere in this star system.

changes.english: SOLANUM: Conscious observance forces a quantum object to collapse to a single possibility. But what would happen if a conscious observer somehow entered the Eye itself?
changes.previous: SOLANUM: Conscious observation forces a quantum object to collapse to a single possibility. But what would happen if a conscious observer somehow entered the Eye itself?
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：对一个量子对象进行有意识地观察，将会使其坍缩为单一的可能态。但要是一个有意识的观察者进入眼，那么又会发生什么事情呢？
changes.key: SOLANUM: Conscious observation forces a quantum object to collapse to a single possibility. But what would happen if a conscious observer somehow entered the Eye itself?

changes.english: SOLANUM: Over time, this has become my clan’s greatest question.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: Over time, this has become my clan’s greatest question.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：渐渐地，这个问题成为了我的家族最大的疑问。
changes.key: SOLANUM: Over time, this has become my clan’s greatest question.

changes.english: SOLANUM: I am Solanum, a Nomai. My clan arrived in this star system before my birth, and now we call it home.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: I am Solanum, a Nomai. My clan arrived in this star system before my birth, and we now call it home.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：我叫所莱内姆，是一名挪麦人。在我出生之前，我的家族就来到了这个星系。如今，我们在这里安了家。
changes.key: SOLANUM: I am Solanum, a Nomai. My clan arrived in this star system before my birth, and we now call it home.

changes.english: SOLANUM: I am on my first pilgrimage to the Quantum Moon. All Nomai in my clan make this journey when we come of age.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: I am on my first pilgrimage to the Quantum Moon. All Nomai in my clan make this journey when we come of age.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：我正要前往量子卫星，进行首次朝圣。在我的家族里，所有的挪麦人一旦到了足够的年纪，都会踏上这样的旅程。
changes.key: SOLANUM: I am on my first pilgrimage to the Quantum Moon. All Nomai in my clan make this journey when we come of age.

changes.english: SOLANUM: Even though the Eye cannot be reached from here, the Quantum Moon remains special to us, as it carries us nearer to the Eye than any other place we know.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: Even though the Eye cannot be reached from here, the Quantum Moon remains special to us, as it carries us nearer to the Eye than any other place we know.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：虽然从这里无法抵达眼，但量子卫星对我们而言依然意义非凡。和别的地方相比，它可以带着我们来到最为靠近眼的地方。
changes.key: SOLANUM: Even though the Eye cannot be reached from here, the Quantum Moon remains special to us, as it carries us nearer to the Eye than any other place we know.

changes.english: SOLANUM: These are the two tenets of Nomai philosophy; to seek out and understand is our way of living.
changes.previous: SOLANUM: These are the two tenets of Nomai philosophy; to seek out and to understand is our way of living.
changes.chinese: 所莱内姆：挪麦人信奉两大人生信条；寻找和理解是我们生命的意义。
changes.key: SOLANUM: These are the two tenets of Nomai philosophy; to seek out and to understand is our way of living.

changes.english: CASSAVA: This is it: We've finished building the final Orbital Probe Cannon module and are ready to send it into orbit around Giant’s Deep for assembly!
changes.previous: CASSAVA: This is it: We’ve finished building the final Orbital Probe Cannon module and are ready to send it into orbit around Giant’s Deep for assembly!
changes.chinese: 卡萨瓦：行了：我们已经完成了轨道探测炮最终模块的建造，并准备把它送入深巨星的轨道进行组装！
changes.key: CASSAVA: This is it: We’ve finished building the final Orbital Probe Cannon module and are ready to send it into orbit around Giant’s Deep for assembly!

changes.english: CASSAVA: Our next step will be to send Privet up to the Orbital Probe Cannon to install the probe tracking system.
changes.previous: CASSAVA: Our next step will be to send Privet up to the Orbital Probe Cannon to install the probe tracking system.
changes.chinese: 卡萨瓦：下一步，我们要把普利维特送上轨道探测炮来安装探测跟踪系统。
changes.key: CASSAVA: Our next step will be to send Privet up to the Orbital Probe Cannon to install the probe tracking system.

changes.english: CASSAVA: To all my friends here at the Construction Yard, my gratitude for your tireless work. I had given up hope, but I truly believe this cannon may actually succeed where many other attempts have not.
changes.previous: CASSAVA: To all my friends here at the Construction Yard, my gratitude for your tireless work. I had given up hope, but I truly believe this cannon may actually succeed where many other attempts have not.
changes.chinese: 卡萨瓦：所有建造厂的朋友们，我感激你们孜孜不倦的劳作。我曾经失去了希望，但我真诚地相信这门大炮可以实现许多前人无法实现的成就。
changes.key: CASSAVA: To all my friends here at the Construction Yard, my gratitude for your tireless work. I had given up hope, but I truly believe this cannon may actually succeed where many other attempts have not.

changes.english: DAZ: Are you going gelatinous on us, love? I'm delighted by your words, but they're atypical for you!
changes.previous: DAZ: Are you going gelatinous on us, love? I’m delighted by your words, but they’re atypical for you!
changes.chinese: 戴兹：你在跟我们套近乎吗，亲爱的？你的话让我很高兴，但那也太不像你了！
changes.key: DAZ: Are you going gelatinous on us, love? I’m delighted by your words, but they’re atypical for you!

changes.english: CASSAVA: If I'm ever half as gooey as Mallow and Avens behave together, darling, you may launch *me* from the Orbital Probe Cannon.
changes.previous: CASSAVA: If I’m ever half as gooey as Mallow and Avens behave together, Daz, you may launch me from the Orbital Probe Cannon.
changes.chinese: 卡萨瓦：要是我有玛罗和埃文斯加起来一半软弱，戴兹，你就把我装在轨道探测炮里发射出去。
changes.key: CASSAVA: If I’m ever half as gooey as Mallow and Avens behave together, Daz, you may launch me from the Orbital Probe Cannon.

changes.english: DAZ: If I know my brother, Avens (and his spouse) will want to launch the probe with as much power as possible. I'm worried the cannon would break under the strain.
changes.previous: DAZ: If I know my brother, Avens (and his spouse) will want to launch the probe with as much power as possible. I’m worried the cannon would break under the strain.
changes.chinese: 戴兹：我了解我的兄弟，埃文斯（和他的配偶）会动用一切可能的动力来发射探测器。我担心大炮会承受不住而坏掉。
changes.key: DAZ: If I know my brother, Avens (and his spouse) will want to launch the probe with as much power as possible. I’m worried the cannon would break under the strain.

changes.english: DAZ: I propose we give Avens and Mallow a slightly lower maximum power setting than the absolute maximum possible to create room for their enthusiasm.
changes.previous: DAZ: I propose we give Avens and Mallow a slightly lower maximum power setting than the absolute maximum possible to create room for their enthusiasm.
changes.chinese: 戴兹：我建议我们给埃文斯和玛罗分配动力的时候，在最大绝对值的基础上稍微做一点削减，为他们的工作热忱创造一些空间。
changes.key: DAZ: I propose we give Avens and Mallow a slightly lower maximum power setting than the absolute maximum possible to create room for their enthusiasm.

changes.english: CASSAVA: I have bad news, Avens. Yarrow says there was a problem with the proposed power source, so the Orbital Probe Cannon won't be asked to fire.
changes.previous: CASSAVA: I have bad news, Avens. Yarrow says there was a problem with the proposed power source, so the Orbital Probe Cannon won’t be asked to fire.
changes.chinese: 卡萨瓦：我有一些坏消息，埃文斯。亚罗说推荐的动力源出了问题，无法请求轨道探测炮进行发射。
changes.key: CASSAVA: I have bad news, Avens. Yarrow says there was a problem with the proposed power source, so the Orbital Probe Cannon won’t be asked to fire.

changes.english: AVENS: I hope you're pulling my locomotive limb here, Cassava.
changes.previous: AVENS: I hope you’re pulling my locomotive limb here, Cassava.
changes.chinese: 埃文斯：但愿你是在跟我开玩笑，卡萨瓦。
changes.key: AVENS: I hope you’re pulling my locomotive limb here, Cassava.

changes.english: CASSAVA: I wish I were, my friend, but no. They aren't certain they can fix the problem, so the Orbital Probe Cannon is on an indefinite hiatus.
changes.previous: CASSAVA: I wish I were, my friend, but no. They aren’t certain they can fix the problem, so the Orbital Probe Cannon is on indefinite hiatus.
changes.chinese: 卡萨瓦：要是真的是这样就好了。他们无法确定问题出在哪儿，也修不好，所以轨道探测炮只能无限期搁置。
changes.key: CASSAVA: I wish I were, my friend, but no. They aren’t certain they can fix the problem, so the Orbital Probe Cannon is on indefinite hiatus.

changes.english: CASSAVA: Tell Privet and Mallow they should return from the cannon. Me and Daz will remain at the Construction Yard, for now.
changes.previous: CASSAVA: Tell Privet and Mallow they should return from the cannon. My spouse and I will remain at the Construction Yard, for now.
changes.chinese: 卡萨瓦：告诉普利维特和玛罗，让他们从大炮那儿回来。我的配偶和我暂时要留在建造厂。
changes.key: CASSAVA: Tell Privet and Mallow they should return from the cannon. My spouse and I will remain at the Construction Yard, for now.

changes.english: AVENS: An update: Mallow and I will join you and Daz. Privet left to visit her brother. She fears Idaea may feel responsible.
changes.previous: AVENS: An update: Mallow and I will join you and Daz. Privet left to visit her brother. She fears Idaea may feel responsible.
changes.chinese: 埃文斯：更新：玛罗和我会来找你和戴兹。普利维特去找她的兄弟了。她担心伊代亚会有自责情绪。
changes.key: AVENS: An update: Mallow and I will join you and Daz. Privet left to visit her brother. She fears Idaea may feel responsible.

changes.english: LAMI: They're going to test the memory statues tonight! Phlox says it could be dangerous, so we can't come.
changes.previous: LAMI: They’re going to test the memory statues tonight! Phlox says it could be dangerous, so we can’t come.
changes.chinese: 拉米：他们今天晚上要去测试回忆雕像！弗拉克斯说现场可能会很危险，所以我们不能去。
changes.key: LAMI: They’re going to test the memory statues tonight! Phlox says it could be dangerous, so we can’t come.

changes.english: LAMI: *But,* what if we didn't use the door and snuck in the *other* way? Does anyone want to?
changes.previous: LAMI: But, what if we didn’t use the door and snuck in the other way? Does anyone want to?
changes.chinese: 拉米：不过，假如我们不走大门，从别的地方摸进去呢？有谁想去吗？
changes.key: LAMI: But, what if we didn’t use the door and snuck in the other way? Does anyone want to?

changes.english: TAGET: Phlox *specifically* told us not to do that.
changes.previous: TAGET: Phlox specifically told us not to do that.
changes.chinese: 塔格特：弗拉克斯特别跟我们强调过别那么做。
changes.key: TAGET: Phlox specifically told us not to do that.

changes.english: LAEVI: I really want to see the test too, Lami, but that's a huge risk to take. We probably shouldn't. Maybe Phlox'll let us see a later test.
changes.previous: LAEVI: I really want to see the test, too, Lami, but that’s a huge risk to take. We probably shouldn’t. Maybe Phlox’ll let us see a later test.
changes.chinese: 莱阿维：我也非常想去看看试验的情况，拉米，但是这样做太冒险了。也许我们不该去。也许弗拉克斯会让我们去参观一次后期试验。
changes.key: LAEVI: I really want to see the test, too, Lami, but that’s a huge risk to take. We probably shouldn’t. Maybe Phlox’ll let us see a later test.

changes.english: PHLOX: Yarrow, would you kindly step back so Daz is closest to the statue? When pairing, the statue will choose whoever is in closest proximity.
changes.previous: PHLOX: Yarrow, would you kindly step back so Daz is closest to the statue? When pairing, the statue will choose whoever is in closest proximity.
changes.chinese: 弗拉克斯：亚罗，能不能请你退后一点？这样戴兹才能距离雕像最近。到时候，雕像会选择最近的人来进行匹配。
changes.key: PHLOX: Yarrow, would you kindly step back so Daz is closest to the statue? When pairing, the statue will choose whoever is in closest proximity.

changes.english: PHLOX: …See how its eyes have opened? That tells us the statue has paired with Daz. Now, no matter where he is in this star system, Daz's statue will record his memories and send them to the Ash Twin Project.
changes.previous: PHLOX: ...See how its eyes have opened? That tells us the statue has paired with Daz. Now, no matter where he is in this star system, Daz’s statue will record his memories and send them to the Ash Twin Project.
changes.chinese: 弗拉克斯：……看见它睁开眼睛的样子了吗？这说明雕像已经和戴兹进行了匹配。现在，不管戴兹处在这个星系的什么地方，雕像都会把他的回忆记录下来，并发往灰烬双星计划。
changes.key: PHLOX: ...See how its eyes have opened? That tells us the statue has paired with Daz. Now, no matter where he is in this star system, Daz’s statue will record his memories and send them to the Ash Twin Project.

changes.english: YARROW: This is extraordinary sculpting work, Phlox!
changes.previous: YARROW: This is extraordinary sculpting work, Phlox!
changes.chinese: 亚罗：弗拉克斯，你的这座雕像真是非凡！
changes.key: YARROW: This is extraordinary sculpting work, Phlox!

changes.english: DAZ: He has outdone himself again, hasn't he? And now that we have our first successful pairing, we can test my memory storage prototype.
changes.previous: DAZ: He has outdone himself again, hasn’t he? And now that we have our first successful pairing, we can test my memory storage prototype.
changes.chinese: 戴兹：他再次突破了自己，对不对？既然第一例匹配已经成功，那么我们现在可以测试一下我的回忆存储原型了。
changes.key: DAZ: He has outdone himself again, hasn’t he? And now that we have our first successful pairing, we can test my memory storage prototype.

changes.english: DAZ: Each statue will send a single Nomai’s memories to his or her own storage unit within the Ash Twin.
changes.previous: DAZ: Each statue will send a single Nomai’s memories to his or her own storage unit within Ash Twin.
changes.chinese: 戴兹：每座雕像都会把一个挪麦人的回忆发送到他或者她自己位于灰烬双星的存储单元里。
changes.key: DAZ: Each statue will send a single Nomai’s memories to his or her own storage unit within Ash Twin.

changes.english: PHLOX: Each storage unit will be equipped with a mask, the statue’s counterpart, which will be able to send those stored memories back to the corresponding Nomai.
changes.previous: PHLOX: Each storage unit will be equipped with a mask, the statue’s counterpart, which will be able to send those stored memories back to the corresponding Nomai.
changes.chinese: 弗拉克斯：每个存储单元都配有和雕像成对的面具，可以将那些存储起来的回忆重新发送给相应的挪麦人。
changes.key: PHLOX: Each storage unit will be equipped with a mask, the statue’s counterpart, which will be able to send those stored memories back to the corresponding Nomai.

changes.english: RAMIE: I've installed the masks inside the Ash Twin Project, Phlox. They look beautiful (although I do feel as though I'm being observed!).
changes.previous: RAMIE: I’ve installed the masks inside the Ash Twin Project, Phlox. They look beautiful (although I do feel as though I’m being observed!).
changes.chinese: 瑞米：弗拉克斯，我已经安装好了灰烬双星计划内部的面具。它们看上去很漂亮（不过我觉得它们好像在观察我！）。
changes.key: RAMIE: I’ve installed the masks inside the Ash Twin Project, Phlox. They look beautiful (although I do feel as though I’m being observed!).

changes.english: RAMIE: It's comforting to know the statues will not pair until the project succeeds. Otherwise, I imagine the experience would be hard to endure!
changes.previous: RAMIE: It’s comforting to know the statues will not pair until the project succeeds. Otherwise, I imagine the experience would be hard to endure!
changes.chinese: 瑞米：还好雕像在计划成功之前不会进行匹配。不然的话，那一定是叫人难以忍受的体验！
changes.key: RAMIE: It’s comforting to know the statues will not pair until the project succeeds. Otherwise, I imagine the experience would be hard to endure!

changes.english: PHLOX: Ideally, they'll only need to activate once the project succeeds; as a safety measure, however, the states will also activate in the event of equipment failure.
changes.previous: PHLOX: Ideally, they’ll only need to activate once the project succeeds; as a safety measure, however, the statues will also activate in the event of equipment failure.
changes.chinese: 弗拉克斯：理想的情况下，我们只需要在计划成功时启动它们；不过作为安全措施，这些雕像也会在设备出现故障的时候被启动。
changes.key: PHLOX: Ideally, they’ll only need to activate once the project succeeds; as a safety measure, however, the statues will also activate in the event of equipment failure.

changes.english: RAMIE: They will? Why is that?
changes.previous: RAMIE: They will? Why is that?
changes.chinese: 瑞米：真的吗？那是为什么？
changes.key: RAMIE: They will? Why is that?

changes.english: PHLOX: If anything goes wrong with the Ash Twin Project, the statues (and their masks) will make us aware of the situation and enable us to fix it. Otherwise, it would be possible for us to remain permanently unaware of the problem.
changes.previous: PHLOX: If anything goes wrong with the Ash Twin Project, the statues (and their masks) will make us aware of the situation and enable us to fix it. Otherwise, it would be possible for us to remain permanently unaware of the problem.
changes.chinese: 弗拉克斯：如果灰烬双星计划出现问题，雕像（还有它们的面具）可以把情况通知给我们，让我们进行修复。不然的话，我们就可能永远也不知道出了什么问题。
changes.key: PHLOX: If anything goes wrong with the Ash Twin Project, the statues (and their masks) will make us aware of the situation and enable us to fix it. Otherwise, it would be possible for us to remain permanently unaware of the problem.

changes.english: RAMIE: I hadn't thought of that! What a profoundly horrific thought that would be.
changes.previous: RAMIE: I hadn’t thought of that! What a profoundly horrific fate that would be.
changes.chinese: 瑞米：这我倒是没想过！那将会多么可怕的情况啊。
changes.key: RAMIE: I hadn’t thought of that! What a profoundly horrific fate that would be.

changes.english: Be welcomed in this place. This tower shares with all who ask the knowledge needed to make his or her first quantum journey.
changes.previous: Be welcomed in this place. This tower shares with all who ask the knowledge needed to make his or her first quantum journey.
changes.chinese: 欢迎来到这个地方。这座高塔有求必应，会和任何人分享他或者她踏上第一次量子之旅需要了解的知识。
changes.key: Be welcomed in this place. This tower shares with all who ask the knowledge needed to make his or her first quantum journey.

changes.english: Enter this place without friends, however; these are lessons to learn for yourself.
changes.previous: Enter this place without friends, however; these are lessons to learn for yourself.
changes.chinese: 但是，只能孤身进入；其中的道理你要自己去领会。
changes.key: Enter this place without friends, however; these are lessons to learn for yourself.

changes.english: Seek the wondering arch.
changes.previous: Seek the wandering arch.
changes.chinese: 寻找流浪拱门。
changes.key: Seek the wandering arch.

changes.english: Observing a quantum object; observing an image of a quantum object. These are the same.
changes.previous: Observing a quantum object; observing an image of a quantum object. These are the same.
changes.chinese: 观察一个量子对象；观察一个量子对象的图形。它们是一样的事情。
changes.key: Observing a quantum object; observing an image of a quantum object. These are the same.

changes.english: The arch and the crystal do not naturally meet.
changes.previous: The arch and the crystal do not naturally meet.
changes.chinese: 拱门和水晶无法自然交汇。
changes.key: The arch and the crystal do not naturally meet.

changes.english: This is the last one (but we made it harder)
changes.previous: This is the last one (but we made it harder).
changes.chinese: 这是最后一个（但是我们增加了难度）。
changes.key: This is the last one (but we made it harder).

changes.english: We offer our congratulations! You've learned the rule of quantum imaging. Take this knowledge with you on the remainder of your quantum pilgrimage.
changes.previous: We offer our congratulations! You’ve learned the rule of quantum imaging. Take this knowledge with you on the remainder of your quantum pilgrimage.
changes.chinese: 在此献上我们的祝贺！你已学会了量子成像法则。就带着这个知识伴你度过余下的量子朝圣之旅。
changes.key: We offer our congratulations! You’ve learned the rule of quantum imaging. Take this knowledge with you on the remainder of your quantum pilgrimage.

changes.english: Remember, the other quantum shards have other lessons to teach.
changes.previous: Remember, the other quantum shards have other lessons to teach.
changes.chinese: 记住，其它的内容可以从别的量子碎片那里学习。
changes.key: Remember, the other quantum shards have other lessons to teach.

changes.english: Our curiosity goes with you on your journey. You walk in the footsteps of those who came before you, and your path guides those who will follow later.
changes.previous: Our curiosity goes with you on your journey. You walk in the footsteps of those who came before you, and your path guides those who will follow later.
changes.chinese: 我们对你的旅程充满好奇心。你将跟随前人的脚步，带领后人走向正确的道路。
changes.key: Our curiosity goes with you on your journey. You walk in the footsteps of those who came before you, and your path guides those who will follow later.

changes.english: YARROW: I have exciting news, Privet: the Ash Twin Project is almost prepared to receive the probe data from the Orbital Probe Cannon.
changes.previous: YARROW: I have exciting news, Privet: The Ash Twin Project is almost prepared to receive the probe data from the Orbital Probe Cannon.
changes.chinese: 亚罗：我有一些激动人心的消息，普利维特：灰烬双星计划即将准备就绪，可以接受轨道探测炮传来的探测器数据了。
changes.key: YARROW: I have exciting news, Privet: The Ash Twin Project is almost prepared to receive the probe data from the Orbital Probe Cannon.

changes.english: YARROW: Ramie is adding some finishing touches here, but she'll be finished soon. Are you and the Orbital Probe Cannon well?
changes.previous: YARROW: Ramie is adding some finishing touches here, but she’ll be finished soon. Are you and the Orbital Probe Cannon well?
changes.chinese: 亚罗：瑞米正在做最后的收尾工作，不过她马上就能完工。你和轨道探测炮都没问题吧？
changes.key: YARROW: Ramie is adding some finishing touches here, but she’ll be finished soon. Are you and the Orbital Probe Cannon well?

changes.english: PRIVET: We are! The Probe Tracking Module is ready to record each launch's flight trajectory and will automatically transmit all relevant data to you.
changes.previous: PRIVET: We are! The statue here in the Probe Tracking Module is ready to record each launch’s flight trajectory and will automatically transmit all relevant data to you.
changes.chinese: 普利维特：没问题！探测器跟踪模块已经就绪，能够记录每次发射的飞行轨迹，并且会把相关的数据自动传给你。
changes.key: PRIVET: We are! The statue here in the Probe Tracking Module is ready to record each launch’s flight trajectory and will automatically transmit all relevant data to you.

changes.english: PRIVET: On the other appendage, I'm now worried about this cannon's structural integrity and its crew's moral integrity.
changes.previous: PRIVET: On the other appendage, I’m now worried about this cannon’s structural integrity and its crew’s moral integrity.
changes.chinese: 普利维特：而另一方面，我现在担心的是这门大炮的结构还有乘员的精神是不是健全。
changes.key: PRIVET: On the other appendage, I’m now worried about this cannon’s structural integrity and its crew’s moral integrity.

changes.english: PRIVET: Once the probe determines the location of the Eye of the universe, I'll send an alert directly to you and Ramie.
changes.previous: PRIVET: Once the probe determines the location of the Eye of the universe, I’ll send an alert directly to you and Ramie.
changes.chinese: 普利维特：一旦探测器发现宇宙之眼的位置，我就会直接通知你和瑞米。
changes.key: PRIVET: Once the probe determines the location of the Eye of the universe, I’ll send an alert directly to you and Ramie.

changes.english: MALLOW: Imagine Privet: The Probe Tracking Module will be held first to know the coordinates of the Eye of the universe! You'll be the first to see them!
changes.previous: MALLOW: Imagine, Privet: the Probe Tracking Module will be the first to know the coordinates of the Eye of the universe! You’ll be the first to see them!
changes.chinese: 玛罗：想想看，普利维特：探测器跟踪模块将会头一个获取宇宙之眼的坐标！而你则是第一个得知这一坐标的人！
changes.key: MALLOW: Imagine, Privet: the Probe Tracking Module will be the first to know the coordinates of the Eye of the universe! You’ll be the first to see them!

changes.english: PRIVET: I am honoured and terrified!
changes.previous: PRIVET: I am honored and terrified!
changes.chinese: 普利维特：我深感荣幸，惶恐之至！
changes.key: PRIVET: I am honored and terrified!

changes.english: PRIVET: You won't ask them Orbital Probe Cannon to use so much power that it breaks, will you?
changes.previous: PRIVET: You won’t ask the Orbital Probe Cannon to use so much power that it breaks, will you?
changes.chinese: 普利维特：你不会让轨道探测炮动用太多动力，把它给弄坏吧？
changes.key: PRIVET: You won’t ask the Orbital Probe Cannon to use so much power that it breaks, will you?

changes.english: MALLOW: Fret not, my nervous friend! We only need to fire the probe cannon once, anyway, so who minds if it compromises the Orbital Probe Cannon’s structural integrity slightly?
changes.previous: MALLOW: Fret not, my nervous friend! We only need to fire the probe once, anyway, so who minds if it compromises the Orbital Probe Cannon’s structural integrity slightly?
changes.chinese: 玛罗：别紧张，我爱操心的朋友！反正我们只会发射一次探测器，就算是轨道探测炮的结构有轻微的损坏，又会有谁在乎呢？
changes.key: MALLOW: Fret not, my nervous friend! We only need to fire the probe once, anyway, so who minds if it compromises the Orbital Probe Cannon’s structural integrity slightly?

changes.english: PRIVET: I would mind, Mallow! I would mind, because we won't be capable of receiving our probe’s data if the Probe Tracking Module is destroyed!
changes.previous: PRIVET: I would mind, Mallow! I would mind, because we won’t be capable of receiving our probe’s data if the Probe Tracking Module is destroyed!
changes.chinese: 普利维特：我在乎，玛罗！我在乎，因为要是探测器跟踪模块损毁，那我们就没法接受探测器传来的数据了！
changes.key: PRIVET: I would mind, Mallow! I would mind, because we won’t be capable of receiving our probe’s data if the Probe Tracking Module is destroyed!

changes.english: AVENS: Mallow, my better 50 percent! Cassava is sending the last of the cannon components. Soon (relatively speaking), we'll know the Eye’s precise location!
changes.previous: AVENS: Mallow, my better 50 percent! Cassava is sending the last of the cannon components. Soon (relatively speaking), we’ll know the Eye’s precise location!
changes.chinese: 埃文斯：玛罗，我的另一半！卡萨瓦把最后一批大炮部件给送了过来。很快（相对而言），我们就会知道眼的确切位置了！
changes.key: AVENS: Mallow, my better 50 percent! Cassava is sending the last of the cannon components. Soon (relatively speaking), we’ll know the Eye’s precise location!

changes.english: MALLOW: The thought of concluding our elders' curious and challenging search increases my heart's temperature, love!
changes.previous: MALLOW: The thought of concluding our elders’ curious and challenging search increases my heart’s temperature, my love!
changes.chinese: 玛罗：一想到能够解开前人的谜题，结束这次艰难的搜索，我就心跳不止，我的爱人！
changes.key: MALLOW: The thought of concluding our elders’ curious and challenging search increases my heart’s temperature, my love!

changes.english: AVENS: Cassava tells me he and the construction yard crew have determined a power setting we are not, under any circumstances, to go above.
changes.previous: AVENS: Cassava tells me he and the Construction Yard crew have determined a power setting we are not, under any circumstances, to go above.
changes.chinese: 埃文斯：卡萨瓦告诉我，他和建造厂的人员已经规定了动力设置的上限。不管什么情况，我们都不能超出这个上限。
changes.key: AVENS: Cassava tells me he and the Construction Yard crew have determined a power setting we are not, under any circumstances, to go above.

changes.english: MALLOW: I see! Am I right to think that, consequently, we'll be ignoring that setting?
changes.previous: MALLOW: I see! And am I right to think that, consequently, we’ll be ignoring that setting?
changes.chinese: 玛罗：我懂了！我是不是由此可以推断，我们要无视这样的设置？
changes.key: MALLOW: I see! And am I right to think that, consequently, we’ll be ignoring that setting?

changes.english: AVENS: I can posit with nearly 100 percent certainty our friends have accounted for our natures, so I suggest we do!
changes.previous: AVENS: I can posit with nearly 100 percent certainty our friends have accounted for our natures, so I suggest we do!
changes.chinese: 埃文斯：我可以百分之一百地假定，我们的朋友已经把我们的本性给考虑了进去，因此我认为我们应该无视这一设置！
changes.key: AVENS: I can posit with nearly 100 percent certainty our friends have accounted for our natures, so I suggest we do!

changes.english: AVENS: Giving the Orbital Probe Cannon all the power it can structurally withstand creates the greatest chance of finding the Eye of the universe.
changes.previous: AVENS: Giving the Orbital Probe Cannon all the power it can structurally withstand creates the greatest chance of finding the Eye of the universe.
changes.chinese: 埃文斯：把动力提高到轨道探测炮结构所能承受的极限，就可以最大限度地增加发现宇宙之眼的机会。
changes.key: AVENS: Giving the Orbital Probe Cannon all the power it can structurally withstand creates the greatest chance of finding the Eye of the universe.

changes.english: MALLOW: Yes, the probe must travel as fast as it can, as far as it can. I'll make some adjustments!
changes.previous: MALLOW: Yes, the probe must travel as fast as it can, as far as it can. I’ll make some adjustments!
changes.chinese: 玛罗：是的，探测器一定要飞得尽可能快，尽可能远才行。我这就来进行调整！
changes.key: MALLOW: Yes, the probe must travel as fast as it can, as far as it can. I’ll make some adjustments!

changes.english: CASSAVA: I have bad news, Avens. Yarrow says there was a problem with the proposed power source, so the Orbital Probe Cannon won't be asked to fire.
changes.previous: CASSAVA: I have bad news, Avens. Yarrow says there was a problem with the proposed power source, so the Orbital Probe Cannon won’t be asked to fire.
changes.chinese: 卡萨瓦：我有一些坏消息，埃文斯。亚罗说推荐的动力源出了问题，无法请求轨道探测炮进行发射。
changes.key: CASSAVA: I have bad news, Avens. Yarrow says there was a problem with the proposed power source, so the Orbital Probe Cannon won’t be asked to fire.

changes.english: AVENS: I hope you're pulling my locomotive limb here, Cassava.
changes.previous: AVENS: I hope you’re pulling my locomotive limb here, Cassava.
changes.chinese: 埃文斯：但愿你是在跟我开玩笑，卡萨瓦。
changes.key: AVENS: I hope you’re pulling my locomotive limb here, Cassava.

changes.english: CASSAVA: I wish I were, my friend, but no. They aren't certain they can fix the problem, so the Orbital Probe Cannon is on an indefinite hiatus.
changes.previous: CASSAVA: I wish I were, my friend, but no. They aren’t certain they can fix the problem, so the Orbital Probe Cannon is on indefinite hiatus.
changes.chinese: 卡萨瓦：要是真的是这样就好了。他们无法确定问题出在哪儿，也修不好，所以轨道探测炮只能无限期搁置。
changes.key: CASSAVA: I wish I were, my friend, but no. They aren’t certain they can fix the problem, so the Orbital Probe Cannon is on indefinite hiatus.

changes.english: CASSAVA: Tell Privet and Mallow they should return from the cannon. Me and Daz will remain at the Construction Yard, for now.
changes.previous: CASSAVA: Tell Privet and Mallow they should return from the cannon. My spouse and I will remain at the Construction Yard, for now.
changes.chinese: 卡萨瓦：告诉普利维特和玛罗，让他们从大炮那儿回来。我的配偶和我暂时要留在建造厂。
changes.key: CASSAVA: Tell Privet and Mallow they should return from the cannon. My spouse and I will remain at the Construction Yard, for now.

changes.english: AVENS: An update: Mallow and I will join you and Daz. Privet left to visit her brother. She fears Idaea may feel responsible.
changes.previous: AVENS: An update: Mallow and I will join you and Daz. Privet left to visit her brother. She fears Idaea may feel responsible.
changes.chinese: 埃文斯：更新：玛罗和我会来找你和戴兹。普利维特去找她的兄弟了。她担心伊代亚会有自责情绪。
changes.key: AVENS: An update: Mallow and I will join you and Daz. Privet left to visit her brother. She fears Idaea may feel responsible.

changes.english: SECCA: Our escape pod crashed as we tried to flee this place, destroying our movement and communication abilities in the process.
changes.previous: SECCA: Our escape pod crashed as we tried to flee this place, destroying our movement and communication capabilities in the process.
changes.chinese: 塞卡：我们想要逃离这个地方，结果逃生舱坠毁了，我们丧失了移动和通讯能力。
changes.key: SECCA: Our escape pod crashed as we tried to flee this place, destroying our movement and communication capabilities in the process.

changes.english: SECCA: We’ve held out for as long as we could here, but this pod’s supply of breathable air is nearly depleted, and the anglerfish attack more and more frequently.
changes.previous: SECCA: We’ve held out as long as we could here, but this pod’s supply of breathable air is nearly depleted, and the anglerfish attack more and more frequently.
changes.chinese: 塞卡：我们会在这里尽量坚持下去，不过逃生舱的空气补给即将耗尽，安康鱼的进攻也变得越来越频繁。
changes.key: SECCA: We’ve held out as long as we could here, but this pod’s supply of breathable air is nearly depleted, and the anglerfish attack more and more frequently.

changes.english: SECCA: Our best chance at survival is to return to the Vessel to either repair the damage, or, more probably, await rescue.
changes.previous: SECCA: Our best chance at survival is to return to the Vessel to either repair the damage or, more probably, await rescue.
changes.chinese: 塞卡：只有回到飞船那里，把它修好；或者更有可能是在那里等待救援，这样我们活下来的希望才最大。
changes.key: SECCA: Our best chance at survival is to return to the Vessel to either repair the damage or, more probably, await rescue.

changes.english: ESCALL: Secca, is the message finished? The Vessel’s beacon is already growing fainter; it will be gone in a matter of hours. We need to leave here, quickly.
changes.previous: ESCALL: Secca, is the message finished? The Vessel’s beacon is already growing fainter; it will be gone in a matter of hours. We need to leave here, quickly.
changes.chinese: 艾斯科尔：塞卡，消息结束了吗？飞船的信标已经开始减弱了，不出几个小时它就会消失。我们得尽快离开这里。
changes.key: ESCALL: Secca, is the message finished? The Vessel’s beacon is already growing fainter; it will be gone in a matter of hours. We need to leave here, quickly.

changes.english: DIN: There is a new problem: our equipment is detecting two distinct beacons from the Vessel.
changes.previous: DIN: There is a new problem: Our equipment is detecting two distinct beacons from the Vessel.
changes.chinese: 迪恩：有一个新的问题：我们的设备在两个不同的地方检测到了飞船发出的信标。
changes.key: DIN: There is a new problem: Our equipment is detecting two distinct beacons from the Vessel.

changes.english: SECCA: But it isn’t possible for the Vessel to be in two different locations at the same time.
changes.previous: SECCA: But it isn’t possible for the Vessel to be in two different locations at the same time.
changes.chinese: 塞卡：可是飞船不可能同时出现在两个地方啊。
changes.key: SECCA: But it isn’t possible for the Vessel to be in two different locations at the same time.

changes.english: DIN: I agree, but the beacons are exactly identical to each other. Perhaps if I had more time-
changes.previous: DIN: I agree, but the beacons are exactly identical to each other. Perhaps if I had more time —
changes.chinese: 迪恩：我同意，但这两个信标是完全相同的。也许再给我一点时间的话……
changes.key: DIN: I agree, but the beacons are exactly identical to each other. Perhaps if I had more time —

changes.english: SECCA: We’re nearly out of time already, Din; the Vessel’s beacon is quickly fading. Soon, it will be gone, and we will be lost.
changes.previous: SECCA: We’re nearly out of time already, Din; the Vessel’s beacon is quickly fading. Soon, it will be gone, and we will be lost.
changes.chinese: 塞卡：我们已经快没时间了，迪恩；飞船的信标正在迅速衰减。很快它就会消失，到时候我们就找不到路了。
changes.key: SECCA: We’re nearly out of time already, Din; the Vessel’s beacon is quickly fading. Soon, it will be gone, and we will be lost.

changes.english: ESCALL: We will follow the beacon whose source is closest to us.
changes.previous: ESCALL: We will follow the beacon whose source is nearest to us.
changes.chinese: 艾斯科尔：我们要跟着信标源最近的那个信标走。
changes.key: ESCALL: We will follow the beacon whose source is nearest to us.

changes.english: DIN: But suppose that beacon is false!
changes.previous: DIN: But suppose that beacon is false!
changes.chinese: 迪恩：但万一那个信标是假的呢！
changes.key: DIN: But suppose that beacon is false!

changes.english: ESCALL: We likely don’t have enough air to reach the farther of the two beacons, Din. The decision is made for us.
changes.previous: ESCALL: We likely don’t have enough air to reach the farther of the two beacons, Din. The decision is made for us.
changes.chinese: 艾斯科尔：我们不大可能有足够的空气去寻找比较远的那个信标，迪恩。我们别无选择。
changes.key: ESCALL: We likely don’t have enough air to reach the farther of the two beacons, Din. The decision is made for us.

changes.english: ESCALL: We’ll leave a trail of lights as we go. There’s still a chance someone could hear our escape pod’s distress signal.
changes.previous: ESCALL: We’ll leave a trail of lights as we go. There’s still a chance someone could hear our escape pod’s distress signal.
changes.chinese: 艾斯科尔：我们一边走一边在路上留下发光路标。别人依然有可能会收到我们的逃生舱发出来的信号。
changes.key: ESCALL: We’ll leave a trail of lights as we go. There’s still a chance someone could hear our escape pod’s distress signal.

changes.english: SECCA: To any who come here searching for us: we followed one of the two beacons from the Vessel to this place, but now can go no further.
changes.previous: SECCA: To any who come here searching for us: We followed one of the two beacons from the Vessel to this place, but now can go no further.
changes.chinese: 塞卡：给来找我们的人：我们跟着飞船发出的两个信标之一来到了这个地方，但现在我们没法继续前进了。
changes.key: SECCA: To any who come here searching for us: We followed one of the two beacons from the Vessel to this place, but now can go no further.

changes.english: SECCA: It’s almost too faint to hear now, but the Vessel’s beacon is still faintly emitting from within this thorny seed. Yet the opening is too small for a single Nomai to fit through, so our escape pod couldn’t have flown through here.
changes.previous: SECCA: It's almost too faint to hear now, but the Vessel’s beacon is still faintly emitting from within this thorny seed. Yet the opening is too small for even a single Nomai to fit through it, so our escape pod couldn’t have flown through here.
changes.chinese: 塞卡：信号现在已经快接收不到了，但是飞船的信标还在从这个带刺的种子里向外进行微弱的发射。开口太小，就连一个挪麦人都钻不过去，所以我们的逃生舱没办法飞进去。
changes.key: SECCA: It’s almost too faint to hear now, but the Vessel’s beacon is still faintly emitting from within this thorny seed. Yet the opening is too small for even a single Nomai to fit through it, so our escape pod couldn’t have flown through here.

changes.english: SECCA: I don’t understand how this could be possible, but this gruesome place seems able to manipulate space itself; maybe this was our undoing.
changes.previous: SECCA: I don’t understand how this could be possible, but this gruesome place seems able to manipulate space itself; maybe this was our undoing.
changes.chinese: 塞卡：我不明白这怎么可能，不过这个可怕的地方貌似能够操控空间；也许这就是我们末日。
changes.key: SECCA: I don’t understand how this could be possible, but this gruesome place seems able to manipulate space itself; maybe this was our undoing.

changes.english: SECCA: To be so close to the location of the Vessel and still so far is… difficult. Worse, the Vessel’s beacon is dying; soon, we will be unable to hear it.
changes.previous: SECCA: To be so close to the location of the Vessel and still so far is... difficult. Worse, the Vessel’s beacon is dying; soon, we will be unable to hear it.
changes.chinese: 塞卡：飞船的位置就在眼前，可要找到它却……如此困难。更糟糕的是，飞船的信标正在衰减；很快我们就要接收不到信号了。
changes.key: SECCA: To be so close to the location of the Vessel and still so far is... difficult. Worse, the Vessel’s beacon is dying; soon, we will be unable to hear it.

changes.english: SECCA: There is nothing we can do now but try to perhaps find a way inside, or at least attempt to comprehend why this happened.
changes.previous: SECCA: There is nothing we can do now but try to perhaps find a way inside, or at least attempt to comprehend why this happened.
changes.chinese: 塞卡：现在我们什么都做不了，只能试着看看能不能想办法进去，或者至少弄清楚为什么会发生这样的事情。
changes.key: SECCA: There is nothing we can do now but try to perhaps find a way inside, or at least attempt to comprehend why this happened.

changes.english: SECCA: My dearest hope is that the other escape pods were able to reach relative safety.
changes.previous: SECCA: My dearest hope is that the other escape pods were able to reach relative safety.
changes.chinese: 塞卡：我最大的愿望就是其它逃生舱落到了相对安全的地方。
changes.key: SECCA: My dearest hope is that the other escape pods were able to reach relative safety.

changes.english: FILIX: I’m recording now - I’ve never encountered anything like this! The signal the Vessel is receiving seems to be *older than the universe itself*!
changes.previous: FILIX: I’m recording now — I’ve never encountered anything like this! The signal the Vessel is receiving appears to be older than the universe itself!
changes.chinese: 费利克斯：我正在做记录，我从没见过这样的事情！飞船收到的信号貌似比宇宙本身还要古老！
changes.key: FILIX: I’m recording now — I’ve never encountered anything like this! The signal the Vessel is receiving appears to be older than the universe itself!

changes.english: ESCALL: This is our first contact with anything of this nature. Everyone, prepare to warp immediately!
changes.previous: ESCALL: This is our first contact with anything of this nature. Everyone, prepare to warp immediately!
changes.chinese: 艾斯科尔：这是我们第一次接触到这种情况。所有人，准备立刻跃迁！
changes.key: ESCALL: This is our first contact with anything of this nature. Everyone, prepare to warp immediately!

changes.english: FILIX: Escall, wait! I need more time to send an outgoing message! Shouldn’t we tell another clan where we’re going?
changes.previous: FILIX: Escall, wait, I need more time to send an outgoing message! Shouldn’t we tell another clan where we’re going?
changes.chinese: 费利克斯：艾斯科尔，等等，我需要一点时间来向外发送消息！难道我们不该把自己的目的地告诉其他家族吗？
changes.key: FILIX: Escall, wait, I need more time to send an outgoing message! Shouldn’t we tell another clan where we’re going?

changes.english: ESCALL: We can send the message on arrival. This extraordinary signal appeared suddenly; it may disappear just as quickly, and we can’t lose a discovery this incredible! Focus on preparing for the warp, instead.
changes.previous: ESCALL: We can send the message upon our arrival. This extraordinary signal appeared suddenly; it may disappear just as quickly, and we can’t lose a discovery this incredible! Focus on preparing for the warp, instead.
changes.chinese: 艾斯科尔：消息可以在我们抵达后再发。这个非同寻常的信号是突然出现的；它可能也会瞬间消失，我们不能失去如此重大的发现！还是集中精神为跃迁做好准备吧。
changes.key: ESCALL: We can send the message upon our arrival. This extraordinary signal appeared suddenly; it may disappear just as quickly, and we can’t lose a discovery this incredible! Focus on preparing for the warp, instead.

changes.english: FILIX: I understand!
changes.previous: FILIX: I understand!
changes.chinese: 费利克斯：我明白了！
changes.key: FILIX: I understand!

changes.english: ESCALL: Annona, is the Vessel ready to warp to the signal’s approximate coordinates?
changes.previous: ESCALL: Annona, is the Vessel ready to warp to the signal’s approximate coordinates?
changes.chinese: 艾斯科尔：安诺纳，飞船准备好跃迁到信号的大致坐标上了吗？
changes.key: ESCALL: Annona, is the Vessel ready to warp to the signal’s approximate coordinates?

changes.english: ANNONA: The warp core is powered, but this will be a significant jump. Afterward, we’ll need time to recharge the core.
changes.previous: ANNONA: The warp core is powered, but this will be a significant jump. Afterward, we’ll need time to recharge the core.
changes.chinese: 安诺纳：跃迁核心充能完毕，但这次跃迁的距离十分遥远。我们之后需要花时间为核心重新充能。
changes.key: ANNONA: The warp core is powered, but this will be a significant jump. Afterward, we’ll need time to recharge the core.

changes.english: ESCALL: That shouldn’t create a problem, provided we arrive at or near the signal’s source. Everyone, we’re ready to warp!
changes.previous: ESCALL: That shouldn’t create a problem, provided we arrive at or near the signal’s source. Everyone, we’re ready to warp!
changes.chinese: 艾斯科尔：只要我们能够抵达信号源的位置或是附近，那就应该不成问题。所有人，我们准备跃迁！
changes.key: ESCALL: That shouldn’t create a problem, provided we arrive at or near the signal’s source. Everyone, we’re ready to warp!

changes.english: FILIX: This is Escall’s Vessel; something went badly wrong during our warp, and our Vessel is mortally wounded. We need help as quickly as possible!
changes.previous: FILIX: This is Escall’s Vessel; something went badly wrong during our warp, and our Vessel is mortally wounded. We need help as quickly as possible!
changes.chinese: 费利克斯：这里是艾斯科尔的飞船；我们的跃迁出了大问题，我们的飞船遭受严重损伤。我们需要尽快得到帮助！
changes.key: FILIX: This is Escall’s Vessel; something went badly wrong during our warp, and our Vessel is mortally wounded. We need help as quickly as possible!

changes.english: FILIX: Our Vessel appears to have… has it *fused* with the local environment, somehow? There are vines that are now part of the Vessel! It’s been torn apart from inside itself!
changes.previous: FILIX: Our Vessel appears to have... has it fused with the local environment, somehow? There are vines that are now part of the Vessel! It’s been torn apart from inside itself!
changes.chinese: 费利克斯：我们的飞船好像……好像和当地环境融合在了一起？如今藤蔓也变成了飞船的一部分！它在内部拆卸自己！
changes.key: FILIX: Our Vessel appears to have... has it fused with the local environment, somehow? There are vines that are now part of the Vessel! It’s been torn apart from inside itself!

changes.english: FILIX: We… we are abandoning our Vessel. Any Nomai clans or spaceflight-capable species receiving, I implore you, we need your help!
changes.previous: FILIX: We... we are abandoning our Vessel. Any Nomai clans or spaceflight-capable species receiving this message, I implore you, we need your help!
changes.chinese: 费利克斯：我们……我们要放弃飞船了。收到这个消息的挪麦家族，或是具有太空航行能力的种族，我恳请你们，我们需要你们的帮助！
changes.key: FILIX: We... we are abandoning our Vessel. Any Nomai clans or spaceflight-capable species receiving this message, I implore you, we need your help!

changes.english: FILIX: Is this broken? Can anyone hear me? Our Vessel is dying! We need immediate assistance!
changes.previous: FILIX: Is this broken? Can anyone hear me? Our Vessel is dying! We need immediate assistance!
changes.chinese: 费利克斯：这东西坏了吗？有人能听见吗？我们的飞船正在死亡！我们急需援助！
changes.key: FILIX: Is this broken? Can anyone hear me? Our Vessel is dying! We need immediate assistance!

changes.english: CANNA: To any Nomai Clans whose Vessels can hear this message:
changes.previous: CANNA: To any Nomai clans whose Vessels can hear this message:
changes.chinese: 卡纳：所有能够收到这个消息的挪麦家族飞船注意：
changes.key: CANNA: To any Nomai clans whose Vessels can hear this message:

changes.english: CANNA: It’s clear the universe is dying. There are fewer and fewer resources and safe places within space now, so my clan and I believe the best option is for all of our clans to stay together.
changes.previous: CANNA: It’s clear the universe is dying. There are fewer and fewer resources and safe places within space now, so my clan and I believe the best option is for all of our clans to stay together.
changes.chinese: 卡纳：很明显，这个宇宙正在死亡。太空里安全的地方越来越少，资源也是一样。因此我的家族和我认为，最好的办法就是让所有的家族都团结在一起。
changes.key: CANNA: It’s clear the universe is dying. There are fewer and fewer resources and safe places within space now, so my clan and I believe the best option is for all of our clans to stay together.

changes.english: CANNA: If you can reach the Gloaming Galaxy, we’ve found that Blackrock’s suns are fairly stable, and life in this star system is (comparatively) thriving. We live in relative safety.
changes.previous: CANNA: If you can reach the Gloaming Galaxy, we’ve found that Blackrock’s suns are fairly stable, and life in this star system is (comparatively) thriving. We live in relative safety.
changes.chinese: 卡纳：如果你能够前往暮色银河那就最好，我们已经发现黑石星系的太阳比较稳定，这个星系的生命比较起来还算是繁荣。在这里生活，我们可以稍微安全一些。
changes.key: CANNA: If you can reach the Gloaming Galaxy, we’ve found that Blackrock’s suns are fairly stable, and life in this star system is (comparatively) thriving. We live in relative safety.

changes.english: BROMI: Canna, we’re making our way to you.
changes.previous: BROMI: Canna, we’re making our way to you.
changes.chinese: 布洛密：卡纳，我们正在朝你那里进发。
changes.key: BROMI: Canna, we’re making our way to you.

changes.english: CANNA: Has anyone heard from Neem? His clan was on its way to our Vessel, but they never arrived, and he hasn’t sent any messages. I’m beginning to worry.
changes.previous: CANNA: Has anyone heard from Neem? His clan was on its way to our Vessel, but they never arrived, and he hasn’t sent any messages. I’m beginning to worry.
changes.chinese: 卡纳：有尼姆的消息？他的家族正在朝我们的飞船前进，但一直没能抵达。而且他也没有发来任何消息。我开始有点担心了。
changes.key: CANNA: Has anyone heard from Neem? His clan was on its way to our Vessel, but they never arrived, and he hasn’t sent any messages. I’m beginning to worry.

changes.english: BROMI: That *is* unsettling. It reminds me of that old myth my grandfather used to tell, the Disappearance of Escall.
changes.previous: BROMI: That is unsettling. It reminds me of that old myth my grandfather used to tell, the Disappearance of Escall.
changes.chinese: 布洛密：那可真是不妙啊。我想起了祖父以前常常挂在嘴边的一个古老传说：艾斯科尔的失踪。
changes.key: BROMI: That is unsettling. It reminds me of that old myth my grandfather used to tell, the Disappearance of Escall.

changes.english: CLEM: I remember hearing that story as a child! One day, Escall’s Vessel simply stopped responding. The other clans searched and searched, but found no trace. It was as if their missing friends had warped out of existence.
changes.previous: CLEM: I remember hearing that story as a child! One day, Escall’s Vessel simply stopped responding. The other clans searched and searched, but found no trace. It was as if their missing friends had warped out of existence.
changes.chinese: 克莱姆：我记得小时候听过这个故事！有一天，艾斯科尔的飞船突然没了消息。其他家族找了又找，可是一无所获。仿佛他们的朋友们就这样彻底消失不见了。
changes.key: CLEM: I remember hearing that story as a child! One day, Escall’s Vessel simply stopped responding. The other clans searched and searched, but found no trace. It was as if their missing friends had warped out of existence.

changes.english: HYSSOP: That’s no myth, friends: Escall’s clan existed, and their story was real.
changes.previous: HYSSOP: That’s no myth, friends; Escall’s clan existed, and their story was real.
changes.chinese: 希索普：那可不是什么传说，朋友们。艾斯科尔家族曾经存在过，他们的故事也是真的。
changes.key: HYSSOP: That’s no myth, friends; Escall’s clan existed, and their story was real.

changes.english: BROMI: What a curious event to have passed into myth! Our ancestors’ ancestors were told that story when they were young. Are you sure it’s true, Hyssop?
changes.previous: BROMI: What a curious event to have passed into myth! Our ancestors’ ancestors were told that story when they were young. Are you sure it’s true, Hyssop?
changes.chinese: 布洛密：这样一个离奇的事件，怎么就成了传说呢！那是我们祖先的祖先在小时候听长辈说的故事。你确定这个事情是真的吗，希索普？
changes.key: BROMI: What a curious event to have passed into myth! Our ancestors’ ancestors were told that story when they were young. Are you sure it’s true, Hyssop?

changes.english: HYSSOP: It was a very long time ago, but yes. My clan’s ancestors searched for Escall’s clan for a long time, but in the end, none of them were ever seen again. (It’s the only time a Vessel has ever disappeared in this way.)
changes.previous: HYSSOP: It was a very long time ago, but yes. My clan’s ancestors searched for Escall’s clan for a long time, but in the end, none of them were ever seen again. (It’s the only time in our history a Vessel has ever disappeared this way.)
changes.chinese: 希索普：事情已经过去很久了。不过它的确是真的。我们家族的祖先花了很长时间来寻找艾斯科尔家族。但是到了最后，谁都没有再听说过他们的消息。（飞船以这种方式失踪，在我们的历史上这是唯一的一次。）
changes.key: HYSSOP: It was a very long time ago, but yes. My clan’s ancestors searched for Escall’s clan for a long time, but in the end, none of them were ever seen again. (It’s the only time in our history a Vessel has ever disappeared this way.)

changes.english: NEEM: Hyssop, I hope you aren’t comparing Escall’s story to my clan’s vessel!
changes.previous: NEEM: Hyssop, I hope you aren’t comparing Escall’s story to my clan’s Vessel!
changes.chinese: 尼姆：希索普，但愿你不是在拿艾斯科尔的故事和我们家族的飞船打比方！
changes.key: NEEM: Hyssop, I hope you aren’t comparing Escall’s story to my clan’s Vessel!

changes.english: CLEM: Neem, my friend! We feared you were gone!
changes.previous: CLEM: Neem, my friend! We feared you were gone!
changes.chinese: 克莱姆：尼姆，我的朋友！我们还担心你是不是失踪了呢！
changes.key: CLEM: Neem, my friend! We feared you were gone!

changes.english: NEEM: Not yet, we aren’t, but nearly. We found trouble during our warp: the triple suns of the Bright Spark star system exploded, and it was only a lucky coincidence we weren’t caught in the blast. We’ll meet you soon, Canna!
changes.previous: NEEM: Not yet, we aren’t, but nearly. We found trouble during our warp: The triple suns of the Bright Spark star system exploded, and it was only a lucky coincidence we weren’t caught in the blast. We’ll meet you soon, Canna!
changes.chinese: 尼姆：这倒是没有，不过就差一点。我们在跃迁的时候遇到了麻烦：闪耀火花星系的三颗太阳爆发了。算我们走运，这才没被卷进去。我们待会儿见，卡纳！
changes.key: NEEM: Not yet, we aren’t, but nearly. We found trouble during our warp: The triple suns of the Bright Spark star system exploded, and it was only a lucky coincidence we weren’t caught in the blast. We’ll meet you soon, Canna!

changes.english: CANNA: I’m relieved your clan is safe, Neem! It’s good to hear your words. Any clan nearby, remember to be extremely cautious of potentially unstable stars (which is most of them, now).
changes.previous: CANNA: I’m relieved your clan is safe, Neem! It’s good to hear your words. Any Vessels nearby, remember to be extremely cautious of potentially unstable stars (which is most of them, now).
changes.chinese: 卡纳：你的家族没事可真是太好了，尼姆！很高兴能够收到你的消息。附近所有的飞船，请多加小心可能出现的不稳定恒星。就目前而言，大部分恒星都不稳定。
changes.key: CANNA: I’m relieved your clan is safe, Neem! It’s good to hear your words. Any Vessels nearby, remember to be extremely cautious of potentially unstable stars (which is most of them, now).

changes.english: POKE: The white hole cores are for the six warp receivers. Each warp tower leads to a different planet, so that will be a greater pain in your cervical spine (Yarrow knows the exact locations).
changes.chinese: 珀克：白洞核心是给跃迁接收点准备的。六个接收点都建在不同的位置，这下你颈椎该疼得厉害了。
changes.key: POKE: The white hole cores are for the warp receivers. Each of the six receivers are being constructed at different locations, so those deliveries will be a greater pain in your cervical spine.

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Welcome to the White Hole Station! Did you fall through the black hole by accident? (Don’t worry; you aren’t the first.) You can use this warp tower to return to Brittle Hollow.
spirals.zh: 珀克：欢迎来到白洞站！如果你不小心掉进了黑洞（别担心，你不是第一个），这座跃迁塔可以把你送回碎空星。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Warp towers work like this: Stand in the middle of the platform on the floor, look up, and wait.

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: The path opens when the tower’s corresponding astral body (in this case, Brittle Hollow) is directly overhead.

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Welcome to the White Hole Station! If you fell through the black hole by accident (don't worry, you aren’t the first), this warp tower can return you to Brittle Hollow.
spirals.zh: 珀克：欢迎来到白洞站！如果你不小心掉进了黑洞（别担心，你不是第一个），这座跃迁塔可以把你送回碎空星。

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: Every warp tower is tuned to a specific astral body. A tower's warp can only be used during the brief window when the tower is aligned with its corresponding astral body (in this case, Brittle Hollow).
spirals.zh: 珀克：每座挪麦跃迁塔都与某一特定天体匹配。珀克：每座跃迁塔都与某一特定天体匹配。只有在对准对应天体的短暂时间内，跃迁塔才能执行跃迁（这座塔对应的是碎空星）。
spirals.zh_key: POKE: Every warp tower is tuned to a specific astral body. A tower's warp can only be used during the brief window when the tower is aligned with its corresponding astral body (in this case, Brittle Hollow).

spirals.text: You must be standing on the warp platform on the floor during this alignment to be warped.
spirals.zh: 要进行跃迁，你必须在对准时站在地上的跃迁平台上。
spirals.zh_key: You must be standing on the warp platform on the floor during this alignment to be warped.

spirals.speaker: POKE
spirals.text: If you look up while the station is rotating, you can see the alignment happens when the astral body is directly overhead.
spirals.zh: 珀克：如果在白洞站旋转时向上看，你可以看到对准的过程，那时天体会在你的正上方。
spirals.zh_key: POKE: If you look up while the station is rotating, you can see the alignment happens when the astral body is directly overhead.
